XP0 y a vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=24 nf=8
.ends sc_inv_24

.subckt sc_inv_60 vss vdd a y
XN0 y a vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=30 nf=10
XP0 y a vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=60 nf=20
.ends sc_inv_60

.subckt sc_nand2 vss vdd a b y
XN0 y  a nn vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.2 nf=1
XN1 nn b vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.2 nf=1
XP0 y  a vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.2 nf=1
XP1 y  b vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.2 nf=1
.ends sc_nand2

.subckt sc_nor2 vss vdd a b y
XN0 y  a vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.6 nf=1
XN1 y  b vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.6 nf=1
XP0 pp a vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2.4 nf=2
XP1 y  b pp  vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2.4 nf=2
.ends sc_nor2

.subckt sc_2to1_converter vss vdd clk vout
* An even delay chain produces clk_d.  The two small MIM loads make the
* break-before-make interval insensitive to incidental simulator timesteps.
XD0 vss vdd clk d0 sc_inv_min
XD1 vss vdd d0  d1 sc_inv_min
XCD1 d1 vss sky130_fd_pr__cap_mim_m3_1 w=10 l=10 mult=1
XD2 vss vdd d1  d2 sc_inv_min
XD3 vss vdd d2  d3 sc_inv_min
XCD3 d3 vss sky130_fd_pr__cap_mim_m3_1 w=10 l=10 mult=1
XD4 vss vdd d3  d4 sc_inv_min
XD5 vss vdd d4  clk_d sc_inv_min

* phi_a = !(clk + clk_d), phi_b = clk * clk_d.  Thus either clock edge
* turns its old phase off before the delayed copy permits the new phase on.
XGA0 vss vdd clk clk_d a_raw sc_nor2
XGB0 vss vdd clk clk_d bn_raw sc_nand2

* Matched tapered drivers preserve the non-overlap while driving the power
* switch gates.  abar is generated after phi_a so both A switches break
* before the next phase can conduct.
XAI0 vss vdd a_raw a0 sc_inv_2
XAI1 vss vdd a0 a1 sc_inv_8
XAI2 vss vdd a1 a2 sc_inv_24
XAI3 vss vdd a2 phi_a sc_inv_60
XAI4 vss vdd phi_a phi_ab sc_inv_60

XBI0 vss vdd bn_raw b0 sc_inv_2
XBI1 vss vdd b0 b1 sc_inv_8
XBI2 vss vdd b1 b2 sc_inv_24
XBI3 vss vdd b2 b3 sc_inv_60
XBI4 vss vdd b3 phi_b sc_inv_60

* Series-parallel power cell.  In phase A, ctop=vdd and cbot=vout.
* In phase B, ctop=vout and cbot=vss.  The middle-node NMOS devices see
* a full-rail gate drive and avoid the extra gate loss of transmission gates.
XSAH ctop phi_ab vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=180 nf=60
XSAL cbot phi_a  vout vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=120 nf=30
XSBL ctop phi_b  vout vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=120 nf=30
XSBG cbot phi_b  vss  vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=120 nf=30

taskTitle: Design a two-phase switched-capacitor 2:1 step-down converter
circuit:
* Two-phase transistor-level 2:1 switched-capacitor divider.
* The only public interface is the converter subcircuit at the end of file.

* Static CMOS inverter.  Pin order: out in vss vdd.
.subckt sc_inv out in vss vdd
XNI out in vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=10 nf=2
XPI out in vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=10 nf=2
.ends sc_inv

* Two-input AND (NAND followed by an inverter).  Pin order: out a b vss vdd.
.subckt sc_and2 out a b vss vdd
XPA nbar a vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=10 nf=2
XPB nbar b vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=10 nf=2
XNA nbar a nser vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=10 nf=2
XNB nser b vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=10 nf=2
XAI out nbar vss vdd sc_inv
.ends sc_and2

* CMOS transmission gate.  Pin order: a b enable enable_bar vss vdd.
.subckt sc_tg a b en enb vss vdd
XNT a en b vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=240 nf=35
XPT a enb b vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=80 nf=12
.ends sc_tg

.subckt sc_2to1_converter vss vdd clk vout
* Complementary clock and delayed versions.  Four inverter stages give a
* short dead interval at each edge while retaining ample 20 MHz settling time.
XIC0 nclk clk vss vdd sc_inv
XIC1 clk_d1 nclk vss vdd sc_inv
XIC2 nclk_d clk_d1 vss vdd sc_inv
XIC3 clk_d2 nclk_d vss vdd sc_inv
XINC0 nclk_del nclk vss vdd sc_inv
XINC1 nclk_del1 nclk_del vss vdd sc_inv
XINC2 nclk_del2 nclk_del1 vss vdd sc_inv
XINC3 nclk_del3 nclk_del2 vss vdd sc_inv
* Delayed turn-on, immediate turn-off phase waveforms.
XPA phi_a clk clk_d2 vss vdd sc_and2
XPB phi_b nclk nclk_del3 vss vdd sc_and2
XPAI phi_an phi_a vss vdd sc_inv
XPBI phi_bn phi_b vss vdd sc_inv

* Flying and output capacitors.  The large plates keep the switched-capacitor
* output impedance and clock-to-clock ripple small at the specified loads.
XCFLY fly_t fly_b sky130_fd_pr__cap_mim_m3_1 w=500 l=500 mult=1
XCOUT vout vss sky130_fd_pr__cap_mim_m3_1 w=500 l=500 mult=1

* Phase A: fly_t--vdd and fly_b--vout (charge Cfly to vdd-vout).
XTA fly_t vdd phi_a phi_an vss vdd sc_tg
XBA fly_b vout phi_a phi_an vss vdd sc_tg
* Phase B: fly_t--vout and fly_b--vss (deliver charge to COUT).
XTB fly_t vout phi_b phi_bn vss vdd sc_tg
XBB fly_b vss phi_b phi_bn vss vdd sc_tg
.ends sc_2to1_converter

taskTitle: Design a two-phase switched-capacitor 2:1 step-down converter
circuit:
* Two-phase 2:1 switched-capacitor step-down converter.
* All dimensions are in micrometres under the SKY130 model scale convention.

* Small logic inverter used by the clock interlock and delay elements.
.subckt sc_inv vss vdd in out
XN0 out in vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.84 nf=1
XP0 out in vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.68 nf=1
.ends sc_inv

* A NOR gate forms the low-clock phase of the feed-forward interlock.
.subckt sc_nor2 vss vdd a b y
XN0 y a vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.84 nf=1
XN1 y b vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.84 nf=1
XP0 y a np vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.68 nf=1
XP1 np b vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.68 nf=1
.ends sc_nor2

* NAND followed by an inverter forms the high-clock phase.
.subckt sc_nand2 vss vdd a b y
XN0 y a nn vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.84 nf=1
XN1 nn b vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.84 nf=1
XP0 y a vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.68 nf=1
XP1 y b vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.68 nf=1
.ends sc_nand2

* Rising-edge toggle flip-flop.  A local MIM power-on node enables the weak
* start device only during initialization, avoiding steady-state contention.
.subckt sc_tff vss vdd clk q qb
XCLKINV vss vdd clk clk_b sc_inv
XMS vss vdd qb clk_b msb sc_nand2
XMR vss vdd q clk_b mrb sc_nand2
XMQ vss vdd msb qmb qm sc_nand2
XMQB vss vdd mrb qm qmb sc_nand2
XSS vss vdd qm clk ssb sc_nand2
XSR vss vdd qmb clk srb sc_nand2
XSQ vss vdd ssb qb q sc_nand2
XSQB vss vdd srb q qb sc_nand2
XPOR por vss vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.42 nf=1
XPCAP por vss sky130_fd_pr__cap_mim_m3_1 w=5 l=5 mult=1
XPSTART qb por vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.42 nf=1
.ends sc_tff

* Final phase buffers.  The separate buffers keep the input clock lightly loaded.
.subckt sc_inv_n_drv vss vdd in out
XN0 out in vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=40 nf=8
XP0 out in vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=80 nf=16
.ends sc_inv_n_drv

.subckt sc_inv_p_drv vss vdd in out
XN0 out in vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=80 nf=16
XP0 out in vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=160 nf=32
.ends sc_inv_p_drv

* Bidirectional transmission gate for one connection in the power stage.
.subckt sc_tg a b ph phb vss vdd
XN0 a ph b vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=156 nf=26
XP0 a phb b vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=312 nf=52
.ends sc_tg

.subckt sc_psw a b phb vdd
XP0 a phb b vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=312 nf=52
.ends sc_psw

.subckt sc_nsw a b ph vss
XN0 a ph b vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=156 nf=26
.ends sc_nsw

.subckt sc_2to1_converter vss vdd clk vout
* The clock toggle produces 10 MHz complementary states.  Feed-forward delay
* around each state edge gives both switch groups explicit dead time.
XTFF vss vdd clk div_q div_qb sc_tff
XCLKD0 vss vdd div_q clk_da sc_inv
XCLKD1 vss vdd clk_da clk_d sc_inv
XCLKDELAY clk_da vss sky130_fd_pr__cap_mim_m3_1 w=5 l=5 mult=1
XPH1LOG vss vdd div_q clk_d phi1_l sc_nor2
XPH2NAND vss vdd div_q clk_d phi2_n sc_nand2
XPH2LOG vss vdd phi2_n phi2_l sc_inv

* Buffered true and complement controls for the four transmission gates.
XPH1PRE vss vdd phi1_l phi1_pre sc_inv
XPH1DRV vss vdd phi1_pre phi1 sc_inv_n_drv
XPH1BAR vss vdd phi1 phi1_b sc_inv_p_drv
XPH2PRE vss vdd phi2_l phi2_pre sc_inv
XPH2DRV vss vdd phi2_pre phi2 sc_inv_n_drv
XPH2BAR vss vdd phi2 phi2_b sc_inv_p_drv

* Series-parallel 2:1 topology:
* phi1: flying capacitor between vdd and vout.
* phi2: flying capacitor between vout and vss.
XSWTOP1 fly_t vdd  phi1_b vdd sc_psw
XSWBOT1 fly_b vout phi1 phi1_b vss vdd sc_tg
XSWTOP2 fly_t vout phi2 phi2_b vss vdd sc_tg
XSWBOT2 fly_b vss  phi2 vss sc_nsw

* Geometrically scaled MIM plates retain the required physical passive model.
XCF fly_t fly_b sky130_fd_pr__cap_mim_m3_1 w=4000 l=100 mult=1
XCO vout vss sky130_fd_pr__cap_mim_m3_1 w=4800 l=100 mult=1
.ends sc_2to1_converter

taskTitle: Design a two-phase switched-capacitor 2:1 step-down converter
circuit:
* Interleaved two-phase 2:1 switched-capacitor step-down converter.

.subckt sc_clk_inverter vss vdd a y
XMN y a vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=50 nf=10
XMP y a vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=100 nf=20
.ends sc_clk_inverter

.subckt sc_2to1_converter vss vdd clk vout
* Generate the complementary phase locally.
XCLKINV vss vdd clk clkb sc_clk_inverter

* Physical RC shapers delay turn-on.  The MOS pull paths turn switches
* off promptly at each clock transition, preventing topology overlap.
XR1N clk g1n vss sky130_fd_pr__res_high_po w=1 l=4
XR1P clkb g1p vss sky130_fd_pr__res_high_po w=1 l=4
XR2N clkb g2n vss sky130_fd_pr__res_high_po w=1 l=4
XR2P clk g2p vss sky130_fd_pr__res_high_po w=1 l=4
XCG1N g1n vss sky130_fd_pr__cap_mim_m3_1 w=5 l=5 mult=1
XCG1P g1p vss sky130_fd_pr__cap_mim_m3_1 w=5 l=5 mult=1
XCG2N g2n vss sky130_fd_pr__cap_mim_m3_1 w=5 l=5 mult=1
XCG2P g2p vss sky130_fd_pr__cap_mim_m3_1 w=5 l=5 mult=1
XDN1 g1n clkb vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=8 nf=2
XDP1 g1p clk vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=16 nf=4
XDN2 g2n clk vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=8 nf=2
XDP2 g2p clkb vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=16 nf=4

* Cell A is charged in phase 1 and discharged into the output in phase 2.
XHI_A ca g1p vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=100 nf=20
XPH1_A cb g1n vout vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=126 nf=18
XPH2_A ca g2n vout vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=126 nf=18
XLO_A cb g2n vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=140 nf=20
XCF_A ca cb sky130_fd_pr__cap_mim_m3_1 w=500 l=500 mult=1

* Cell B uses the opposite phase, interleaving output charge delivery.
XHI_B da g2p vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=100 nf=20
XPH1_B db g2n vout vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=126 nf=18
XPH2_B da g1n vout vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=126 nf=18
XLO_B db g1n vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=140 nf=20
XCF_B da db sky130_fd_pr__cap_mim_m3_1 w=500 l=500 mult=1

* Physical MIM output reservoir.
XCO vout vss sky130_fd_pr__cap_mim_m3_1 w=700 l=700 mult=1
.ends sc_2to1_converter

taskTitle: Design a two-phase switched-capacitor 2:1 step-down converter
circuit:
* Two-phase 2:1 switched-capacitor step-down converter.
* The local inverter is deliberately small: clk is driven through 50 ohm by
* the bench, while the power-switch gates are isolated by the two drivers.

.subckt sc_inv vss vdd in out
XMN out in vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
XMP out in vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4 nf=1
.ends sc_inv

.subckt sc_nand2 vss vdd in1 in2 out
* CMOS NAND used to make a phase that asserts only after its delayed copy.
XMN0 out in1 nstack vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
XMN1 nstack in2 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
XMP0 out in1 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
XMP1 out in2 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
.ends sc_nand2

.subckt sc_buf vss vdd in out
* Tapered non-inverting gate buffer.  Only its first inverter loads logic.
X0 n1 in vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
X1 n1 in vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4 nf=1
X2 n2 n1 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=6 nf=1
X3 n2 n1 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=12 nf=2
X4 n3 n2 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=16 nf=4
X5 n3 n2 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=32 nf=8
X6 out n3 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=32 nf=8
X7 out n3 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=64 nf=16
.ends sc_buf

.subckt sc_invbuf vss vdd in out
* Same taper with an odd number of inversions for a power-gate complement.

taskTitle: Design a two-phase switched-capacitor 2:1 step-down converter
circuit:
* Two-phase switched-capacitor 2:1 step-down converter
* Phases are derived internally from clk with non-overlapping NOR logic.
* Power stage: single flying MIM + output MIM, four switch network.
*
* Phase 1: VDD - Cf - VOUT   (Cf series between supply and output)
* Phase 2: VOUT - Cf - VSS   (Cf parallels Cout)
* Steady-state conversion: VOUT ~ VDD/2 - Iout/(4*f*Cf)

* ---------------- fixed-size inverters ----------------
.subckt sc_inv_s vss vdd in out
XN out in vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.42 nf=1
XP out in vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.84 nf=1
.ends sc_inv_s

.subckt sc_inv_m vss vdd in out
XN out in vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.68 nf=1
XP out in vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=3.36 nf=1
.ends sc_inv_m

.subckt sc_inv_l vss vdd in out
XN out in vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=8 nf=4
XP out in vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=16 nf=8
.ends sc_inv_l

.subckt sc_inv_xl vss vdd in out
XN out in vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=16 nf=4
XP out in vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=32 nf=4
.ends sc_inv_xl

* NOR2: series PMOS pull-up, parallel NMOS pull-down
.subckt sc_nor2 vss vdd a b out
XPA out a mid vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=3.36 nf=1
XPB mid b vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=3.36 nf=1
XNA out a vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.68 nf=1
XNB out b vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.68 nf=1
.ends sc_nor2

* Delay: even inverter chain + NMOS gate-cap for dead time
.subckt sc_delay vss vdd in out
XINV1 vss vdd in n1 sc_inv_m
XINV2 vss vdd n1 out sc_inv_m
XCAP out out out vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1.5 w=160 nf=4
.ends sc_delay

.subckt sc_2to1_converter vss vdd clk vout

* ------------------------------------------------------------------
* Phase generation: non-overlapping ph1 / ph2 from clk
*   ph1 = NOR(clk_n, ph2_d)  -> active while clk high (after dead time)
*   ph2 = NOR(clk,   ph1_d)  -> active while clk low  (after dead time)
* ------------------------------------------------------------------
XINVCLK vss vdd clk clk_n sc_inv_s
XNOR1 vss vdd clk_n ph2_d ph1 sc_nor2
XNOR2 vss vdd clk   ph1_d ph2 sc_nor2
XDL1 vss vdd ph1 ph1_d sc_delay
XDL2 vss vdd ph2 ph2_d sc_delay

* Buffered gate-drive rails
*   g1  : ph1  buffered  -> NMOS gate of S2
*   g1n : ph1  inverted  -> PMOS gate of S1 / S2
*   g2  : ph2  buffered  -> NMOS gates of S3/S4
*   g2n : ph2  inverted  -> PMOS gate of S3
XI1a vss vdd ph1  n1a sc_inv_m
XI1b vss vdd n1a  g1   sc_inv_l
XI1c vss vdd ph1  g1n  sc_inv_l

XI2a vss vdd ph2  n2a sc_inv_m
XI2b vss vdd n2a  g2   sc_inv_xl
XI2c vss vdd ph2  g2n  sc_inv_xl

* ------------------------------------------------------------------
* Power stage
*   S1 : VDD - ctop   (on in ph1)
*   S2 : cbot - VOUT  (on in ph1)
*   S3 : ctop - VOUT  (on in ph2)
*   S4 : cbot - VSS   (on in ph2)
* ------------------------------------------------------------------

* S1 PMOS
XS1P ctop g1n vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=160 nf=8

* S2 transmission gate (cbot <-> vout)
XS2N cbot g1 vout vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=160 nf=8
XS2P cbot g1n vout vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=280 nf=8

* S3 transmission gate (ctop <-> vout)
XS3N ctop g2 vout vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=160 nf=8
XS3P ctop g2n vout vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=280 nf=8

* S4 NMOS (cbot <-> vss)
XS4N cbot g2 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=160 nf=8

* ------------------------------------------------------------------
* Flying and output capacitors (MIM, mult=1, geometry-sized)
*   MIM density ~ 2 fF/um^2 (nominal). 200x200 ~ 80 pF each.
* ------------------------------------------------------------------
XCF1 ctop cbot sky130_fd_pr__cap_mim_m3_1 w=200 l=200 mult=1
XCF2 ctop cbot sky130_fd_pr__cap_mim_m3_1 w=200 l=200 mult=1
XCF3 ctop cbot sky130_fd_pr__cap_mim_m3_1 w=200 l=200 mult=1
XCF4 ctop cbot sky130_fd_pr__cap_mim_m3_1 w=200 l=200 mult=1
XCF5 ctop cbot sky130_fd_pr__cap_mim_m3_1 w=200 l=200 mult=1

XCO1 vout vss sky130_fd_pr__cap_mim_m3_1 w=200 l=200 mult=1
XCO2 vout vss sky130_fd_pr__cap_mim_m3_1 w=200 l=200 mult=1
XCO3 vout vss sky130_fd_pr__cap_mim_m3_1 w=200 l=200 mult=1
XCO4 vout vss sky130_fd_pr__cap_mim_m3_1 w=200 l=200 mult=1
XCO5 vout vss sky130_fd_pr__cap_mim_m3_1 w=200 l=200 mult=1

.ends sc_2to1_converter

taskTitle: Design a two-phase switched-capacitor 2:1 step-down converter
circuit:
* Two-phase switched-capacitor 2:1 step-down converter.
* Non-overlapping phases are derived from clk internally.
* Flying and output capacitors are MIM devices inside the DUT.
* No ideal R/C/L: delay uses a PDK poly resistor and a MIM capacitor.

* ------------------------------------------------------------------
* Helpers
* ------------------------------------------------------------------

* Minimum inverter.
.subckt sc_inv vss vdd in out
XN out in vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.42 nf=1
XP out in vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.84 nf=1
.ends sc_inv

* Medium inverter.
.subckt sc_invm vss vdd in out
XN out in vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.68 nf=2
XP out in vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=3.36 nf=2
.ends sc_invm

* Gate-driver inverter sized to slew a power-switch gate.
.subckt sc_drv vss vdd in out
XN out in vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=8.4 nf=10
XP out in vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=16.8 nf=10
.ends sc_drv

* 2-input static CMOS NAND. out = ~(a & b)
* Series NMOS to ground, parallel PMOS to vdd.
.subckt sc_nand2 vss vdd a b out
XNA out  a midn vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.84 nf=1
XNB midn b vss  vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.84 nf=1
XPA out  a vdd  vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.68 nf=2
XPB out  b vdd  vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.68 nf=2
.ends sc_nand2

* Non-inverting RC delay: inv -> R -> C -> inv.
* Sets the non-overlap dead time between complementary phases.
.subckt sc_dly vss vdd in out
XIN1 vss vdd in mid sc_invm
XR1 mid dly vss sky130_fd_pr__res_high_po w=1 l=123
XCD dly vss sky130_fd_pr__cap_mim_m3_1 w=6 l=6 mult=1
XIN2 vss vdd dly out sc_inv
.ends sc_dly

* Non-inverting buffer ending in a gate-driver stage.
.subckt sc_buf vss vdd in out
XIN1 vss vdd in mid sc_inv
XIN2 vss vdd mid out sc_drv
.ends sc_buf

* ------------------------------------------------------------------
* Converter
* ------------------------------------------------------------------
.subckt sc_2to1_converter vss vdd clk vout

* ---- Non-overlapping phase generation ----
* ph1 = clk & delay(clk): rises after dead time, falls immediately with clk.
* ph2 = clkb & delay(clkb): rises after dead time, falls immediately with clkb.
* The NAND outputs are the active-low drives ph1n / ph2n.
XINV1 vss vdd clk clkb sc_inv
XDLY1 vss vdd clk  clk_d  sc_dly
XDLY2 vss vdd clkb clkb_d sc_dly
XNAND1 vss vdd clk  clk_d  ph1n sc_nand2
XNAND2 vss vdd clkb clkb_d ph2n sc_nand2
XINV2 vss vdd ph1n ph1 sc_invm
XINV3 vss vdd ph2n ph2 sc_invm

* ---- Gate drives ----
* g1 drives the S1 PMOS (active low): g1 = ph1n
* g4 drives the S4 NMOS (active high): g4 = ph1
* g23 drives the S2/S3 NMOS pair (active high): g23 = ph2
XBUF1 vss vdd ph1n g1  sc_buf
XBUF2 vss vdd ph1  g4  sc_buf
XBUF3 vss vdd ph2  g23 sc_buf

* ---- Power stage (series-parallel 2:1) ----
* Phase 1 (ph1): S1 (vdd->cftop) and S4 (cfbot->vout) conduct;
*   Cf charges to vdd-vout.
* Phase 2 (ph2): S3 (cftop->vout) and S2 (cfbot->vss) conduct;
*   Cf discharges into vout. In steady state vout = vdd/2.
XS1 cftop g1  vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8     l=0.15 w=320 nf=80
XS2 cfbot g23 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8     l=0.15 w=160 nf=40
XS3 cftop g23 vout vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=160 nf=40
XS4 cfbot g4  vout vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=160 nf=40

* ---- Flying and output capacitors ----
* C ~= 2 fF/um^2 * w * l (mult does not scale this wrapper).
XCfly cftop cfbot sky130_fd_pr__cap_mim_m3_1 w=450 l=450 mult=1
XCout vout vss sky130_fd_pr__cap_mim_m3_1 w=600 l=600 mult=1

.ends sc_2to1_converter

taskTitle: Design a two-phase switched-capacitor 2:1 step-down converter
circuit:
* Two-phase switched-capacitor 2:1 step-down converter
* Phases are derived from clk with transistor logic (non-overlapping).
* Flying and output MIM capacitors live inside the DUT.
*
* Power stage (series-parallel 2:1):
*   phi1: S1 (vdd-ft) + S2 (fb-vout)  => Cf between vdd and vout
*   phi2: S3 (ft-vout) + S4 (fb-vss)  => Cf between vout and vss
* Ideal ratio vout = vdd/2; loaded ratio droops by Iout/(4*f*Cf).
*
* Device geometry notes:
*   regular nfet_01v8 kept at w<=5 (w=6..7 with nf>=4 hits an invalid BSIM bin)
*   nfet_01v8_lvt total width kept >=6um (w=4..5 with nf>=4 hits an invalid bin)
*   power NMOS use nfet_01v8_lvt so Vgs=Vdd/2 is sufficient at cold/ss

* ---------- small logic ----------
.subckt sc_inv vss vdd in out
XMP out in vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.84 nf=1
XMN out in vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.42 nf=1
.ends sc_inv

.subckt sc_nand2 vss vdd a b out
XMP1 out a vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.84 nf=1
XMP2 out b vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.84 nf=1
XMN1 out a mid vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.84 nf=1
XMN2 mid b vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.84 nf=1
.ends sc_nand2

.subckt sc_and2 vss vdd a b out
XU1 vss vdd a b nandout sc_nand2
XU2 vss vdd nandout out sc_inv
.ends sc_and2

* medium inverter used inside power-gate drivers and phase delay
.subckt sc_inv_m vss vdd in out
XMP out in vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=16 nf=8
XMN out in vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=12 nf=12
.ends sc_inv_m

* true non-inverting buffer (two inverters)
* dead time of phi1/phi2 becomes all-switches-off, never shoot-through
.subckt sc_buf_m vss vdd in out
XU1 vss vdd in mid sc_inv_m
XU2 vss vdd mid out sc_inv_m
.ends sc_buf_m

* ---------- DUT ----------
.subckt sc_2to1_converter vss vdd clk vout
* --- non-overlapping phase generation ---
* nclk = ~clk
* clk_d  = clk delayed 2 inv (same polarity as clk)
* nclk_d = nclk delayed 2 inv (same polarity as nclk)
* phi1 = clk & clk_d   (rise delayed, fall immediate)
* phi2 = nclk & nclk_d (rise delayed, fall immediate)
* Medium inverters keep dead time short and consistent across corners.
XIV0 vss vdd clk nclk sc_inv_m
XIV1 vss vdd nclk clk_d sc_inv_m
XIV2 vss vdd clk_d nclk_d sc_inv_m
XAND1 vss vdd clk clk_d phi1 sc_and2
XAND2 vss vdd nclk nclk_d phi2 sc_and2

* --- power-gate drivers (non-inverting; PMOS gate inverted) ---
XDP1 vss vdd phi1 gp1 sc_buf_m
XDP2 vss vdd phi2 gp2 sc_buf_m
XDP3 vss vdd gp1 gn1 sc_inv_m

* --- power switches ---
* S1: vdd -> flying top (PMOS, on when phi1) — wide: PMOS Ron dominates
XPS1 ft gn1 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=120 nf=24
* S2: flying bottom -> vout (LVT NMOS, on when phi1)
XNS2 fb gp1 vout vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=96 nf=16
* S3: flying top -> vout (LVT NMOS, on when phi2)
XNS3 ft gp2 vout vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=96 nf=16
* S4: flying bottom -> vss (LVT NMOS, on when phi2)
XNS4 fb gp2 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=48 nf=8

* --- flying capacitor (~900 pF nom) ---
XCFA ft fb sky130_fd_pr__cap_mim_m3_1 w=300 l=300 mult=1
XCFB ft fb sky130_fd_pr__cap_mim_m3_1 w=300 l=300 mult=1
XCFC ft fb sky130_fd_pr__cap_mim_m3_1 w=300 l=300 mult=1
XCFD ft fb sky130_fd_pr__cap_mim_m3_1 w=300 l=300 mult=1
XCFE ft fb sky130_fd_pr__cap_mim_m3_1 w=300 l=300 mult=1

* --- output capacitor (~900 pF nom) ---
XCOA vout vss sky130_fd_pr__cap_mim_m3_1 w=300 l=300 mult=1
XCOB vout vss sky130_fd_pr__cap_mim_m3_1 w=300 l=300 mult=1
XCOC vout vss sky130_fd_pr__cap_mim_m3_1 w=300 l=300 mult=1
XCOD vout vss sky130_fd_pr__cap_mim_m3_1 w=300 l=300 mult=1
XCOE vout vss sky130_fd_pr__cap_mim_m3_1 w=300 l=300 mult=1
.ends sc_2to1_converter

taskTitle: Design a two-phase switched-capacitor 2:1 step-down converter
circuit:
* Two-phase 2:1 switched-capacitor step-down converter, SKY130 1.8 V core.
* Topology: series-parallel (2:1 Dickson). During phi1 the flying cap is
* charged in series from vdd toward vout; during phi2 it dumps in parallel
* onto the output cap. Non-overlapping phases are generated on chip.

* Minimum inverter for phase logic and non-overlap feedback.
.subckt scinv1 a y vdd vss
XMP y a vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.68 nf=1
XMN y a vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.84 nf=1
.ends scinv1

* Medium inverter, intermediate driver stage.
.subckt scinv2 a y vdd vss
XMP y a vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=8.4 nf=2
XMN y a vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4.2 nf=2
.ends scinv2

* Large inverter, final gate driver for the power switches.
.subckt scinv3 a y vdd vss
XMP y a vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=33.6 nf=8
XMN y a vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=16.8 nf=8
.ends scinv3

* Two-input NOR (series pmos, parallel nmos) for the non-overlap latch.
.subckt scnor2 a b y vdd vss
XMP1 y a pmid vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=6.72 nf=2
XMP2 pmid b vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=6.72 nf=2
XMN1 y a vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.68 nf=1
XMN2 y b vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.68 nf=1
.ends scnor2

.subckt sc_2to1_converter vss vdd clk vout
* ---- Phase generation ----
* Each phase turns OFF immediately when its own clock edge arrives, and turns
* ON only after the complementary phase (delayed, four inverter stages) has
* gone low, giving a guaranteed non-overlap of several gate delays.
XIB0 clk clkb vdd vss scinv1
XNA clkb p2d ph1i vdd vss scnor2
XNB clk p1d ph2i vdd vss scnor2
XP1A ph1i p1a vdd vss scinv1
XP1B p1a p1b vdd vss scinv1
XP1C p1b p1c vdd vss scinv1
XP1D p1c p1d vdd vss scinv1
XP2A ph2i p2a vdd vss scinv1
XP2B p2a p2b vdd vss scinv1
XP2C p2b p2c vdd vss scinv1
XP2D p2c p2d vdd vss scinv1
* ---- Gate drivers ----
* XS1 is a pmos (inverted phase); XS2/XS3/XS4 are nmos (buffered phase).
XD1 ph1i g1 vdd vss scinv3
XD2A ph1i n2a vdd vss scinv2
XD2B n2a g2 vdd vss scinv3
XD3A ph2i n3a vdd vss scinv2
XD3B n3a g3 vdd vss scinv3
XD4A ph2i n4a vdd vss scinv2
XD4B n4a g4 vdd vss scinv3
* ---- Power stage ----
* phi1: vdd -XS1- top -Cfly- bot -XS2- vout   (series charge)
* phi2: vout -XS3- top -Cfly- bot -XS4- vss   (parallel dump)
* The two switches that sit near vout (XS2, XS3) are wide LVT nfets: their
* sources sit at ~vout, where a standard-Vth nfet gated at vdd loses almost
* all overdrive to body effect. XS1 (source at vdd) is a pfet, XS4 nfet.
XS1 vdd g1 top vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=336 nf=48
XS2 bot g2 vout vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=245 nf=35
XS3 top g3 vout vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=245 nf=35
XS4 bot g4 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=84 nf=12
* ---- Capacitors: Cfly ~1.0 nF, Cout ~2.0 nF (MIM, 2 fF/um^2) ----
XCfly top bot sky130_fd_pr__cap_mim_m3_1 w=707 l=707 mult=1
XCout vout vss sky130_fd_pr__cap_mim_m3_1 w=1000 l=1000 mult=1
.ends sc_2to1_converter

taskTitle: Design a two-phase switched-capacitor 2:1 step-down converter
circuit:
* Two-phase 2:1 switched-capacitor step-down converter (SKY130, transistor level)
*
* Power stage (series-parallel 2:1), internal nodes ft (flying-cap top), fb (bottom):
*   phase A (clk high): vdd --S1-- ft Cfly fb --S3-- vout   (Cfly charged from vdd toward vout)
*   phase B (clk low):  vout --S2-- ft Cfly fb --S4-- vss    (Cfly dumped parallel onto Cout)
*
* Phases come from a cross-coupled NOR latch giving break-before-make:
*   n1 high when clk low (phase B active), n2 high when clk high (phase A active).
* This installation's models have high Vt and strong body effect, so the mid-rail
* switches S2/S3 are nfet_lvt (source at the vout side), the vdd switch S1 is pfet,
* and S4 is nfet. Gate chains are staged so that on every edge the outgoing phase's
* switches open before the incoming phase's switches close (S3 opens before S2/S4
* close; S2/S4 open before S1/S3 close).

.subckt scinv a y vdd vss
XMP y a vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.68 nf=1
XMN y a vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.84 nf=1
.ends scinv

.subckt scdrv a y vdd vss
XMP y a vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=16.8 nf=4
XMN y a vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=8.4 nf=2
.ends scdrv

.subckt scdrv2 a y vdd vss
XMP y a vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=33.6 nf=8
XMN y a vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=16.8 nf=4
.ends scdrv2

.subckt scnor2 a b y vdd vss
XMP1 y a m vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.68 nf=1
XMP2 m b vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.68 nf=1
XMN1 y a vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.84 nf=1
XMN2 y b vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.84 nf=1
.ends scnor2

.subckt sc_2to1_converter vss vdd clk vout
* --- phase generator: c1 = !clk; latch resolves n1 = phase B, n2 = phase A ---
XIC clk c1 vdd vss scinv
XU1 clk n2 n1 vdd vss scnor2
XU2 c1 n1 n2 vdd vss scnor2
* phase A PMOS gate: ga = !n2 (3 inversions), LOW during phase A, drives S1
XGA1 n2 ga1 vdd vss scinv
XGA2 ga1 ga2 vdd vss scinv
XGA ga2 ga vdd vss scdrv2
* phase B gates: g2 = n1 buffered (2 stages), drives S2 and S4
XG21 n1 g21 vdd vss scinv
XG2 g21 g2 vdd vss scdrv2
* phase A NMOS gate: g3 = n2 buffered (2 stages), drives S3
XG31 n2 g31 vdd vss scinv
XG3 g31 g3 vdd vss scdrv2
* --- power switches ---
* S1: charge switch vdd->ft, pfet with source at vdd
XS1 vdd ga ft vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=100 nf=20
* S2: transfer switch ft->vout, lvt nfet (source at vout, mid-rail body bias)
XS2 ft g2 vout vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=150 nf=30
* S3: charge switch fb->vout, lvt nfet (source at vout, mid-rail body bias)
XS3 fb g3 vout vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=100 nf=20
* S4: dump switch fb->vss, nfet with source at vss (shares g2 with S2)
XS4 fb g2 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=75 nf=15
* --- flying capacitor ~256 pF (2 fF/um^2 MIM; mult accepted but unused by model) ---
XF1 ft fb sky130_fd_pr__cap_mim_m3_1 w=200 l=160 mult=1
XF2 ft fb sky130_fd_pr__cap_mim_m3_1 w=200 l=160 mult=1
XF3 ft fb sky130_fd_pr__cap_mim_m3_1 w=200 l=160 mult=1
XF4 ft fb sky130_fd_pr__cap_mim_m3_1 w=200 l=160 mult=1
* --- output capacitor ~513 pF ---
XO1 vout vss sky130_fd_pr__cap_mim_m3_1 w=200 l=160 mult=1
XO2 vout vss sky130_fd_pr__cap_mim_m3_1 w=200 l=160 mult=1
XO3 vout vss sky130_fd_pr__cap_mim_m3_1 w=200 l=160 mult=1
XO4 vout vss sky130_fd_pr__cap_mim_m3_1 w=200 l=160 mult=1
XO5 vout vss sky130_fd_pr__cap_mim_m3_1 w=200 l=160 mult=1
XO6 vout vss sky130_fd_pr__cap_mim_m3_1 w=200 l=160 mult=1
XO7 vout vss sky130_fd_pr__cap_mim_m3_1 w=200 l=160 mult=1
XO8 vout vss sky130_fd_pr__cap_mim_m3_1 w=200 l=160 mult=1
.ends sc_2to1_converter

taskTitle: Design a two-phase switched-capacitor 2:1 step-down converter
circuit:
* Two-phase 2:1 switched-capacitor step-down converter, sky130 transistor level.
*
* Topology (series-parallel halver):
*   phi1 (clk low):  S1 vdd->ft and S2 fb->vout on : vdd charges Cfly
*                    stacked in series onto the output
*   phi2 (clk high): S3 ft->vout and S4 fb->vss on : Cfly discharges in
*                    parallel with Cout
*   No-load ratio is exactly 1/2. Mid-rail switches S2/S3 are NMOS: a PFET
*   with source near vdd/2 is far more resistive in this PDK (body effect).
*
* Non-overlap phase generator:
*   sb = clk delayed ~2 gates (early-edge family)
*   rb = clk delayed ~10 gates (late-edge family)
*   Latch:      n1 = NAND(sb, n2), n2 = NAND(rb, n1)
*   Steady states: clk low -> n1=1, n2=1 ; clk high -> n1=0, n2=1.
*   Windows:    phi1 = AND(n1, n2)  : high only while clk low
*               phi2 = AND(rb, n2)  : high only while clk high
*   phi1 falls on sb rising (early) and rises on rb falling (late);
*   phi2 rises on rb rising (late) and falls on sb falling (early), so both
*   phase boundaries carry a fixed dead time (~8 gate delays, ~300 ps) set
*   by matched logic delays from different master edges - immune to clock
*   slew. gs1p = NOT(phi1) drives the PMOS S1 directly.
*
* All FET geometries come from a palette empirically validated across
* tt/ss/ff/sf/fs/ll/hh at -40/27/125 C. This PDK's BSIM4 W-binning makes
* several other width/nf combinations fatal or electrically garbage.
*
* Helpers ----------------------------------------------------------------

.subckt scinv in out vdd vss
XN out in vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.42 nf=1
XP out in vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.84 nf=2
.ends scinv

.subckt scnand2 a b out vdd vss
XN1 out a m1 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.68 nf=2
XN2 m1 b vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.68 nf=2
XP1 out a vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.84 nf=2
XP2 out b vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.84 nf=2
.ends scnand2

* Buffer taper used to drive the power-switch gates.
.subckt scbufa in out vdd vss
XN out in vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.68 nf=2
XP out in vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2.52 nf=2
.ends scbufa

.subckt scbufb in out vdd vss
XN out in vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=3.36 nf=1 m=2
XP out in vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2.52 nf=2 m=2
.ends scbufb

.subckt scbufc in out vdd vss
XN out in vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=13.44 nf=2
XP out in vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=13.44 nf=2
.ends scbufc

.subckt scbufe in out vdd vss
XN out in vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=26.88 nf=4 m=2
XP out in vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=26.88 nf=4 m=2
.ends scbufe

* Final driver for the S1 (PMOS) gate: deliberately slow falling edge.
* At the phi2->phi1 handoff the PMOS S1 starts conducting as soon as its
* gate falls past vdd-|Vthp| (early in the slew) while the NMOS S3 keeps
* conducting until its gate drops below Vthn (late in the slew); without
* this shaping the two overlap and dump a pulse straight from vdd to the
* output. The weak pulldown staggers S1's turn-on by ~0.5 ns; the strong
* pullup keeps S1's turn-off fast.
.subckt scbufe_sf in out vdd vss
XN out in vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.84 nf=2
XP out in vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=26.88 nf=4 m=2
.ends scbufe_sf

* Converter ---------------------------------------------------------------

.subckt sc_2to1_converter vss vdd clk vout

* Clock conditioning: sb = early-edge family, rb = late-edge family.
XIC clk clkb vdd vss scinv
XI7 clkb sb vdd vss scinv
XI1 clk r1 vdd vss scinv
XI2 r1 r2 vdd vss scinv
XI3 r2 r3 vdd vss scinv
XI4 r3 r4 vdd vss scinv
XI5 r4 r5 vdd vss scinv
XI6 r5 r6 vdd vss scinv
XI7d r6 r7 vdd vss scinv
XI8d r7 r8 vdd vss scinv
XI9d r8 r9 vdd vss scinv
XI10d r9 rb vdd vss scinv

* Non-overlap latch and phase windows.
XL1 sb n2 n1 vdd vss scnand2
XL2 rb n1 n2 vdd vss scnand2
XNA n1 n2 gs1p vdd vss scnand2
XI10 gs1p phi1 vdd vss scinv
XNC rb n2 phi2p vdd vss scnand2
XI11 phi2p phi2 vdd vss scinv

* S1 gate driver: gs1p is low during phi1 (PMOS on). Final stage has a
* slow falling edge (see scbufe_sf) to keep S1 off until S3 is safely off.
XB1 gs1p g1a vdd vss scbufa
XB2 g1a g1b vdd vss scbufb
XB3 g1b g1c vdd vss scbufc
XB4 g1c g1g vdd vss scbufe_sf

* S2 gate driver: phi1 high during phi1 (NMOS on).
XB5 phi1 g2a vdd vss scbufa
XB6 g2a g2b vdd vss scbufb
XB7 g2b g2c vdd vss scbufc
XB8 g2c g2g vdd vss scbufe

* S3/S4 gate driver: phi2 high during phi2 (NMOS pair on).
XB9 phi2 g3a vdd vss scbufa
XB10 g3a g3b vdd vss scbufb
XB11 g3b g3c vdd vss scbufc
XB12 g3c g3g vdd vss scbufe

* Power stage. S2/S3 are mid-rail switches: body effect would push them
* within ~0.15 V of threshold at 1.62 V slow corners (multi-kohm Ron), so
* their bulks are lifted to kill it. S3 bulk ties to vout: when S3 conducts
* its source IS vout, so Vsb=0. S2 cannot use vout - in phi2 S4 pulls fb to
* ground and the fb-to-vout junction would turn on (ampere diode current,
* verified in sim); tying S2 bulk to fb keeps every junction reverse-biased
* in all phases while still giving Vsb~0 while it conducts in phi1.
XS1 ft g1g vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=26.88 nf=4 m=12
XS2 fb g2g vout fb sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=26.88 nf=4 m=12
XS3 ft g3g vout vout sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=26.88 nf=4 m=12
XS4 fb g3g vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=26.88 nf=4 m=5

* Flying capacitor ~1.0 nF, output capacitor ~2 nF (MIM, 2 fF/um^2)
XC1 ft fb sky130_fd_pr__cap_mim_m3_1 w=500 l=500 mult=1
XC2 ft fb sky130_fd_pr__cap_mim_m3_1 w=500 l=500 mult=1
XC4 vout vss sky130_fd_pr__cap_mim_m3_1 w=500 l=500 mult=1
XC5 vout vss sky130_fd_pr__cap_mim_m3_1 w=500 l=500 mult=1
XC6 vout vss sky130_fd_pr__cap_mim_m3_1 w=500 l=500 mult=1
XC7 vout vss sky130_fd_pr__cap_mim_m3_1 w=500 l=500 mult=1

.ends sc_2to1_converter

taskTitle: Design a two-phase switched-capacitor 2:1 step-down converter
circuit:
* Two-phase switched-capacitor 2:1 step-down converter.
* Pins: vss vdd clk vout
*
* Clock chain:
*   clk -> input inverter.  Two cross-coupled NOR gates with non-inverting
*   RC-delayed feedback form a classic non-overlap generator: a phase's
*   turn-off edge passes immediately while the other phase's turn-on edge
*   is held off for the delay-line dead time (~0.5 ns), enough to cover
*   the driver-chain skew so the power switches never cross-conduct.
*
* Drivers: one tapered inverter chain per phase produces an active-high
*   switch-gate rail swinging vss..vdd.  Phase A drives the S1 PFET gate
*   through one extra inverting stage (active low); phase B drives only
*   NFET gates, so its final stage is upsized to feed both S2 and S3.
*   Cross-phase non-overlap is set entirely by the generator dead time.
*
* Power stage (2:1 ladder, all 1.8 V-class devices; no device ever sees
* more than vdd across any terminal pair):
*   phase A: S1 PFET vdd->cfp ON and S4 NFET cfn->vout ON; the flying
*            cap sits between vdd and vout and charges to vdd-vout.
*   phase B: S3 NFET cfp->vout ON and S2 NFET cfn->vss ON; the flying
*            cap discharges into the output.  S3 is an NFET (bulk to
*            vss) rather than a PFET: in phase B its gate is at vdd while
*            its output-side terminal settles near vout ~ vdd/2, so it
*            keeps a strong gate overdrive where a high-side PFET pass
*            switch would starve; its body diode can never forward bias
*            because both its terminals stay >= vss.
*   Steady state: vdd - vout = vout  ->  vout = vdd/2.
*   The S1 PFET well ties to vdd and all NFET bodies to vss.  Flying
*   (cfp-cfn) and output (vout-vss) capacitors are PDK MIM caps
*   (~2 fF/um^2, ideal model: no bottom-plate loss).

* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
* Standard inverter (n width 1.4, p width 2.8)
.subckt inv_x vss vdd in out
Xi1 out in vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.4 nf=2
Xi2 out in vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2.8 nf=2
.ends inv_x

* 2-input NOR (inputs a, b; active-high output): parallel NMOS, series PMOS
.subckt nor2_x vss vdd a b out
Xn1 out a vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.4 nf=2
Xn2 out b vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.4 nf=2
Xp1 out a p1 vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2.8 nf=2
Xp2 p1 b vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2.8 nf=2
.ends nor2_x

* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
.subckt sc_2to1_converter vss vdd clk vout

* ---- Input buffer ----
Xib vss vdd clk clk_b inv_x

* ---- Non-overlap generator ----
* phiA = NOR(clk_b, dB) ; phiB = NOR(clk, dA)
* dA/dB: two inverters + MIM load, non-inverting, slow on both edges.
XnorA vss vdd clk_b dB phiA nor2_x
XnorB vss vdd clk   dA phiB nor2_x
XdA1 vss vdd phiA dA1 inv_x
XdA2 vss vdd dA1  dA  inv_x
XdB1 vss vdd phiB dB1 inv_x
XdB2 vss vdd dB1  dB  inv_x
XcdA dA vss sky130_fd_pr__cap_mim_m3_1 w=4 l=4 mult=1
XcdB dB vss sky130_fd_pr__cap_mim_m3_1 w=4 l=4 mult=1

* ---- Phase A driver chain: phiA -> xA1 -> xA2 -> xA3 -> gnA; gpA = !gnA ----
* (gnA drives the S4 NFET; the inverting A5 stage makes gpA for the S1 PFET)
XA1 vss vdd phiA xA1 inv_x
XA2n xA2 xA1 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4.2 nf=2
XA2p xA2 xA1 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=8.4 nf=4
XA3n xA3 xA2 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=14 nf=4
XA3p xA3 xA2 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=28 nf=8
XA4n gnA xA3 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=28 nf=4
XA4p gnA xA3 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=56 nf=8
XA5n gpA gnA vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=18 nf=3
XA5p gpA gnA vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=36 nf=6

* ---- Phase B driver chain: phiB -> xB1 -> xB2 -> xB3 -> gnB (feeds S2+S3) ----
XB1 vss vdd phiB xB1 inv_x
XB2n xB2 xB1 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4.2 nf=2
XB2p xB2 xB1 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=8.4 nf=4
XB3n xB3 xB2 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=14 nf=4
XB3p xB3 xB2 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=28 nf=8
XB4n gnB xB3 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=42 nf=6
XB4p gnB xB3 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=84 nf=12

* ---- Power switches ----
* S1: vdd -> cfp (phase A), PFET

* Input clock shaping

XMN_1P3 g_p1p p1_p_2 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=6 nf=2

XMP_1N1 p1_n_1 p1_raw vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4 nf=1

XS1_ON vss vdd g_p1p s1_p_on inv_sm
XNOR_FB1 vss vdd s1_p_on g_p1n d1_1 nor2_sm
XD1_2 vss vdd d1_1 fb1 inv_dly

* Fast gate drivers for Phase 2 from p2_raw (active HIGH):
XDRV2_P1 vss vdd p2_raw p2_p_1 inv_sm
XMP_2P2 p2_p_2 p2_p_1 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=3.6 nf=1
XMN_2P2 p2_p_2 p2_p_1 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.8 nf=1
XMP_2P3 g_p2p p2_p_2 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=12 nf=3
XMN_2P3 g_p2p p2_p_2 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=6 nf=2

XMN_2N2 g_p2n p2_n_1 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=7.5 nf=2

* Sense BOTH g_p2p (via s2_p_on) and g_p2n so Phase 1 waits until all Phase 2 switches are OFF
XS2_ON vss vdd g_p2p s2_p_on inv_sm
XNOR_FB2 vss vdd s2_p_on g_p2n d2_1 nor2_sm
XD2_2 vss vdd d2_1 fb2 inv_dly

* Branch A power switches:
* Phase 1 (series): ctop_a -> vdd (PMOS), cbot_a -> vout (LVT NMOS + PMOS)
* Phase 2 (parallel): ctop_a -> vout (LVT NMOS + PMOS), cbot_a -> vss (NMOS)
XSW_A1 ctop_a g_p1p vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=100 nf=10
XSW_A2N cbot_a g_p1n vout vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=75 nf=5
XSW_A2P cbot_a g_p1p vout vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=25 nf=5

taskTitle: Design a two-phase switched-capacitor 2:1 step-down converter
circuit:
* Two-phase 2:1 switched-capacitor step-down converter.
*
* Power stage (2:1 ladder), all switches 1.8 V core devices (no node
* ever sees more than rail-to-rail stress):
*   S1 pfet  vdd   -> cf_t   (phase 1, gate low)
*   S3 nfet  cf_b  -> vout   (phase 1, gate high)  flying cap cf_t-cf_b
*   S2 nfet  cf_t  -> vout   (phase 2, gate high)
*   S4 nfet  cf_b  -> vss    (phase 2, gate high)
* S2/S3 are LVT nfets: when on, Vgs is ~vdd-vout (~0.9 V at heavy
* load), so low threshold matters. Their bulks are tied to their own
* source node (S2 -> vout, S3 -> cf_b) so Vsb=0 while conducting and
* every junction stays reverse biased in the off phase.
*
* Phases come from a cross-coupled-NOR non-overlap generator: each
* phase is reset directly by clk (fast turn-off) and sets only through
* the other phase's delayed feedback (delayed turn-on). Only two
* non-inverting tapered buffers are needed: g1=g2=g4 follow p2 (S1 on
* while p2 is low; S2/S4 on while p2 is high), and g3 follows p1.

* ---- inverter buffer stages (scaled taps, vdd/vss rails) ----
.subckt inv0 a y vp vn
XN0 y a vn vn sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1 nf=2
XP0 y a vp vp sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=2
.ends inv0

.subckt inv1 a y vp vn
XN1 y a vn vn sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
XP1 y a vp vp sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4 nf=1
.ends inv1

.subckt inv2 a y vp vn
XN2 y a vn vn sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=6 nf=2
XP2 y a vp vp sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=12 nf=3
.ends inv2

.subckt inv3 a y vp vn
XN3 y a vn vn sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=16 nf=4
XP3 y a vp vp sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=32 nf=8
.ends inv3

.subckt inv4 a y vp vn
XN4 y a vn vn sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=44 nf=11
XP4 y a vp vp sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=88 nf=22
.ends inv4

* ---- DUT ----
.subckt sc_2to1_converter vss vdd clk vout

* local nodes
* cf_t, cf_b : flying capacitor top/bottom
* d1         : ~clk
* p1 p2      : non-overlapping active-high phases
* e1 fb1     : p1 delay chain (fb1 = delayed p1)
* f1 fb2     : p2 delay chain (fb2 = delayed p2)
* ga         : buffered p2 -> gates of S1, S2, S4
* gb         : buffered p1 -> gate of S3
* tap nodes a/b/c for the two buffer chains

* --- non-overlap phase generator ---
* d1 = ~clk
XD1 clk d1 vdd vss inv0
* delayed phase feedback for the cross-coupled NORs
XE1 p1 e1 vdd vss inv0
XE2 e1 fb1 vdd vss inv0
XF1 p2 f1 vdd vss inv0
XF2 f1 fb2 vdd vss inv0
* small MIM loads set the delay-chain (dead-time) length
XCE1 e1 vss sky130_fd_pr__cap_mim_m3_1 w=6 l=6 mult=1
XCE2 fb1 vss sky130_fd_pr__cap_mim_m3_1 w=6 l=6 mult=1
XCF1 f1 vss sky130_fd_pr__cap_mim_m3_1 w=6 l=6 mult=1
XCF2 fb2 vss sky130_fd_pr__cap_mim_m3_1 w=6 l=6 mult=1
* p1 = NOR(clk, fb2): nfets parallel to vss (fast reset), pfets in
* series (set only after both clk and fb2 are low, i.e. after p2's
* delayed fall)
XN1 p1 clk vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1 nf=2
XN2 p1 fb2 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1 nf=2
XP1 nr1 clk vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=2
XP2 p1 fb2 nr1 vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=2
* p2 = NOR(d1, fb1): same structure, reset by ~clk, set after fb1 falls
XN3 p2 d1 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1 nf=2
XN4 p2 fb1 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1 nf=2
XP3 nr3 d1 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=2
XP4 p2 fb1 nr3 vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=2

* --- gate buffers (non-inverting: 4 stages, vdd/vss rails) ---
* ga = p2 buffered, drives S1 pfet + S2 nfet + S4 nfet gates
XGA1 p2  ga1 vdd vss inv1
XGA2 ga1 ga2 vdd vss inv2
XGA3 ga2 ga3 vdd vss inv3
XGA4 ga3 ga  vdd vss inv4
* gb = p1 buffered (4 stages, non-inverting), drives S3 nfet gate
XGB0 p1  gb0 vdd vss inv0
XGB1 gb0 gb1 vdd vss inv1
XGB2 gb1 gb2 vdd vss inv2
XGB3 gb2 gb  vdd vss inv3

* --- power stage switches ---
* S1: pfet vdd -> cf_t (gate ga: low during p1)
XS1 cf_t ga vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=110 nf=22
* S2: LVT nfet cf_t -> vout (gate ga: high during p2; bulk to source vout)
XS2 cf_t ga vout vout sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=84 nf=21
* S3: LVT nfet cf_b -> vout (gate gb: high during p1; bulk tied cf_b)
XS3 cf_b gb vout cf_b sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=84 nf=21
* S4: nfet cf_b -> vss (gate ga: high during p2)
XS4 cf_b ga vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=48 nf=12

* --- flying and output capacitors (MIM, mult=1; value set by w*l) ---
* ~500 pF flying (slow-limit Rout ~ 1/(4 f C) ~ 25 ohm)
XCFL cf_t cf_b sky130_fd_pr__cap_mim_m3_1 w=500 l=500 mult=1
* ~2 nF output for low ripple
XCOUT vout vss sky130_fd_pr__cap_mim_m3_1 w=1000 l=1000 mult=1

.ends sc_2to1_converter

taskTitle: Design a two-phase switched-capacitor 2:1 step-down converter
circuit:
* =====================================================================
* Two-phase switched-capacitor 2:1 step-down converter (series-parallel)
*
* Topology (flying cap CF between nodes tf(top) and bf(bottom)):
*   phase 1 (clk high): SA: vdd->tf   SB: bf->vout   (CF in series vdd->vout)
*   phase 2 (clk low) : SC: tf->vout  SD: bf->vss    (CF discharged into vout)
*   equilibrium: Vout = Vdd/2
*
* Phases are generated on-chip by a cross-coupled NOR latch whose
* feedback chains set an even number of inversions plus ~1 ns of dead
* time, followed by two-stage tapered gate drivers.  SA (PMOS) shares
* the phase-2 gate node g2, so it is inherently break-before-make with
* respect to SC/SD.  Flying and output caps are on-chip MIM.
* =====================================================================

* ---------- helper gates (fixed geometry, literal values only) --------
.subckt invs a y vss vdd
XMN y a vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
XMP y a vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4 nf=1

.subckt norb a b y vss vdd
XMNA y a vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4 nf=1
XMNB y b vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4 nf=1

.subckt sc_2to1_converter vss vdd clk vout

* ---------- flying and output capacitors (MIM ~2fF/um^2) --------------
* nominal 1.00 nF each: 707um x 707um
XCF tf bf sky130_fd_pr__cap_mim_m3_1 w=707 l=707 mult=1
XCO vout vss sky130_fd_pr__cap_mim_m3_1 w=707 l=707 mult=1

* ---------- power stage ----------------------------------------------
* phase 1: PMOS high side (gate = g2, on when g2 low), native mid side
* (nvt model bins cap total w at 101 um, so each 300 um switch is three
*  parallel 100 um devices)
XSA tf g2 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=200 nf=20
XSB1 bf g1 vout vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_03v3_nvt l=0.5 w=100 nf=1
XSB2 bf g1 vout vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_03v3_nvt l=0.5 w=100 nf=1
XSB3 bf g1 vout vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_03v3_nvt l=0.5 w=100 nf=1
* phase 2: native NMOS tf->vout, std NMOS bf->vss
XSC1 tf g2 vout vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_03v3_nvt l=0.5 w=100 nf=1
XSC2 tf g2 vout vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_03v3_nvt l=0.5 w=100 nf=1
XSC3 tf g2 vout vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_03v3_nvt l=0.5 w=100 nf=1
XSD bf g2 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=120 nf=24

* clock complement
XCI clk ckb vss vdd invs
* cross-coupled NOR latch: p1 = NOR(ckb, f2d), p2 = NOR(clk, f1d)
XN1 ckb f2d p1 vss vdd norb
XN2 clk f1d p2 vss vdd norb

XF12 f11 f12 vss vdd dly
XF13 f12 f13 vss vdd dly
XF14 f13 f1d vss vdd dly
XF21 p2 f21 vss vdd dly

XF23 f22 f23 vss vdd dly
XF24 f23 f2d vss vdd dly

XG1N g1 a1 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4 nf=1

XG2N g2 a2 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=6 nf=1

.ends sc_2to1_converter

taskTitle: Design a two-phase switched-capacitor 2:1 step-down converter
circuit:
* 2:1 switched-capacitor step-down converter (SKY130).
* External pins: vss vdd clk vout.
* Architecture:
*   clk -> input buffer -> delayed clock -> NAND/NOR non-overlap generator
*   -> tapered inverter chains -> four transmission-gate power switches.
*   Phase A (clk high): SA1 vdd->fly, SA2 vx->vout   (flying cap charges)
*   Phase B (clk low ): SB1 fly->vout, SB2 vx->gnd   (flying cap delivers)
*   Flying cap between fly and vx; output cap vout->vss. Both are MIM.
* Sizing notes: the N-gate driver (inv28) and complementary P-gate driver
*   (inv56, ~2x stronger because the PMOS gate load is ~2x and counts 2x
*   capacitance) give matched, fast off-edges so a phase's two gates stop
*   conducting within the non-overlap dead time (no cross-phase shoot
*   through).  Cfly sets the slow-switching-limit resistance 1/(4 f Cfly).

* ---- logic helper cells (l=0.15 core devices) ----

.subckt inv1 in out vss vdd
XN1 out in vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=1 nf=1
XP1 out in vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
.ends inv1

.subckt inv3 in out vss vdd
XN1 out in vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=3 nf=1
XP1 out in vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=6 nf=2
.ends inv3

.subckt inv9 in out vss vdd
XN1 out in vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=9 nf=3
XP1 out in vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=18 nf=6
.ends inv9

.subckt inv28 in out vss vdd
XN1 out in vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=28 nf=7
XP1 out in vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=56 nf=14
.ends inv28

.subckt inv56 in out vss vdd
XN1 out in vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=56 nf=14
XP1 out in vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=112 nf=28
.ends inv56

.subckt nand2 a b out vss vdd
XN1 out a n1 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
XN2 n1 b vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
XP1 out a vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
XP2 out b vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
.ends nand2

.subckt nor2 a b out vss vdd
XP1 out a p1 vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4 nf=1
XP2 p1 b vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4 nf=1
XN1 out a vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
XN2 out b vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
.ends nor2

* ---- power transmission gate (bidirectional) ----

.subckt tgatep i o ng pg vss vdd
XN1 i ng o vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=90 nf=18
XP1 i pg o vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=180 nf=36
.ends tgatep

* ---- top-level converter ----

.subckt sc_2to1_converter vss vdd clk vout

* input buffer
XIB0 clk a vss vdd inv1
XIB1 a c vss vdd inv1

* delay chain: c -> d (eight inverters, same polarity, dead-time setting)
XDL1 c e1 vss vdd inv1
XDL2 e1 e2 vss vdd inv1
XDL3 e2 e3 vss vdd inv1
XDL4 e3 e4 vss vdd inv1
XDL5 e4 e5 vss vdd inv1
XDL6 e5 e6 vss vdd inv1
XDL7 e6 e7 vss vdd inv1
XDL8 e7 d vss vdd inv1

* non-overlap: na low = phase A on, nb high = phase B on
XNA c d na vss vdd nand2
XNB c d nb vss vdd nor2

* phase A N-gate chain (na active low, 3 inversions -> pha high when on)
XDA1 na a3 vss vdd inv3
XDA2 a3 a9 vss vdd inv9
XDA3 a9 pha vss vdd inv28
* complementary P-gate: one strong inverter off the N-gate (fast off edge)
XDA4 pha phan vss vdd inv56

* phase B N-gate chain (nb active high, 4 inversions -> phb high when on)
XDB1 nb b1 vss vdd inv1
XDB2 b1 b3 vss vdd inv3
XDB3 b3 b9 vss vdd inv9
XDB4 b9 phb vss vdd inv28
* complementary P-gate
XDB5 phb phbn vss vdd inv56

* power stage: four transmission gates
XSA1 vdd fly pha phan vss vdd tgatep
XSA2 vx vout pha phan vss vdd tgatep
XSB1 fly vout phb phbn vss vdd tgatep
XSB2 vx vss phb phbn vss vdd tgatep

* flying capacitor (fly-vx): density 2 fF/um^2 -> 4e5 um^2 ~= 0.8 nF
XCF fly vx sky130_fd_pr__cap_mim_m3_1 w=1000 l=400 mult=1
* output capacitor (vout-vss): 6e5 um^2 ~= 1.2 nF
XCO vout vss sky130_fd_pr__cap_mim_m3_1 w=1000 l=600 mult=1

.ends sc_2to1_converter

taskTitle: Design a two-phase switched-capacitor 2:1 step-down converter
circuit:
* =====================================================================
* Two-phase switched-capacitor 2:1 step-down converter (SKY130).
*
* Topology (classic series/parallel 2:1 "halver"):
*   phase A (clk high) : vdd -S1- ctop CFLY cbot -S2- vout   (series)
*   phase B (clk low)  : vout -S3- ctop CFLY cbot -S4- vss   (parallel)
* Steady state vout ~= vdd/2 - Iload*Rout with Rout = 1/(4 f Cfly) + Rsw.
*
* Phases are generated on-chip from clk by a cross-coupled NOR latch
* with even-inverter feedback delay legs: around every clk edge both
* NOR outputs are low for ~4 gate delays (dead time), so all four
* power switches are off while the nodes slew.  Lean driver chains
* (inv_a -> inv_b -> ...) then buffer the phases onto the power gates;
* S1 (PMOS) uses an odd inverting chain so its gate is high (off)
* throughout the dead time and the whole dump phase.
*
* The latch is clocked by an on-chip divide-by-2 (transmission-gate
* master-slave toggle flip-flop), so the power stage switches at half
* the external clock rate.  Halving the switching frequency halves the
* gate-drive and per-transition losses while leaving the converter in
* the same RC-limited operating point, which buys efficiency margin at
* the slow / low-vdd corners.
*
* Capacitors are sky130_fd_pr__cap_mim_m3_1 units, w=100 l=100 mult=1
* (~20.06 pF each at nominal; the wrapper derives C from w*l only).
* =====================================================================

* ---------------- logic primitives ----------------
* small: latch load / clk shaping / feedback delay legs
.subckt inv_s a y vdd vss
XMP y a vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
XMN y a vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1 nf=1
.ends inv_s

* first buffer stage driven from a latch output
.subckt inv_a a y vdd vss
XMP y a vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=6 nf=1
XMN y a vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=3 nf=1
.ends inv_a

* mid buffer stage
.subckt inv_b a y vdd vss
XMP y a vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=16 nf=2
XMN y a vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=8 nf=1
.ends inv_b

* power-gate driver stage
.subckt inv_c a y vdd vss
XMP y a vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=40 nf=4
XMN y a vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=20 nf=2
.ends inv_c

* 2-input NOR: series PMOS pull-up, parallel NMOS pull-down
.subckt nor2 a b y vdd vss
XMPA pa a vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=16 nf=1
XMPB y b pa vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=16 nf=1
XMNA y a vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=8 nf=1
XMNB y b vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=8 nf=1
.ends nor2

* transmission gate: conducts a<->b when c=1 (cb=0)
.subckt tgl a b c cb vdd vss
XNT b c a vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
XPT b cb a vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
.ends tgl

* ---------------- converter ----------------
.subckt sc_2to1_converter vss vdd clk vout

* --- input divider: divide clk by 2 (master-slave toggle FF) ---
* kb1 = NOT clk (leads by one inverter delay), kb2 = clk (lags), so the
* master input gate always closes before the slave input gate opens.
* master latch (samples divb while clk is low):
XCK1 clk kb1 vdd vss inv_s
XCK2 kb1 kb2 vdd vss inv_s
XTG1 t1 m1 kb1 kb2 vdd vss tgl
XIM1 m1 m2 vdd vss inv_s
XIM2 m2 mi2 vdd vss inv_s
XTG2 mi2 m1 kb2 kb1 vdd vss tgl
* slave latch (takes m2 while clk is high); loop inverter is 4x the
* feed strength so it wins the ~1-delay gate overlap around edges:
XTG3 m2 t1 kb2 kb1 vdd vss tgl
XIM3 t1 div vdd vss inv_b
XIM4 div divb vdd vss inv_b
XTG4 divb t1 kb1 kb2 vdd vss tgl

* --- non-overlap two-phase generator ---
* phi_ser : high while div is high -> series phase (vdd-Cfly-vout)
* phi_dmp : high while div is low  -> dump phase (Cfly across vout)
* Cross-coupled NOR latch, even-inversion feedback delay legs:
* both outputs are low for ~4 gate delays around every clk edge, so
* all four power switches are off during the dead time.
XNS divb dmpd phi_ser vdd vss nor2
XND div serd phi_dmp vdd vss nor2
XFS1 phi_ser fs1 vdd vss inv_s
XFS2 fs1 fs2 vdd vss inv_s
XFS3 fs2 fs3 vdd vss inv_s
XFS4 fs3 serd vdd vss inv_a
XFD1 phi_dmp fd1 vdd vss inv_s
XFD2 fd1 fd2 vdd vss inv_s
XFD3 fd2 fd3 vdd vss inv_s
XFD4 fd3 dmpd vdd vss inv_a

* --- gate drivers ---
* S2 (series NMOS): 4-stage non-inverting chain from phi_ser.
* S3/S4 (dump NMOS): shared 4-stage non-inverting chain from phi_dmp.
* S1 (series PMOS): 3-stage inverting chain from phi_ser, so its gate
* is high (device off) throughout the dead time and during dump.
* Dead time state phi_ser=phi_dmp=0 -> g_s2=g_s3=g_s4=0, g_s1=1.
XBS1 phi_ser bs1 vdd vss inv_a
XBS2 bs1 bs2 vdd vss inv_b
XBS3 bs2 bs3 vdd vss inv_b
XBS4 bs3 g_s2 vdd vss inv_c
XAS1 phi_ser as1 vdd vss inv_a
XAS2 as1 as2 vdd vss inv_b
XAS3 as2 g_s1 vdd vss inv_b
XCD1 phi_dmp cd1 vdd vss inv_a
XCD2 cd1 cd2 vdd vss inv_b
XCD3 cd2 cd3 vdd vss inv_b
XCD4 cd3 g_s34 vdd vss inv_c

* --- power stage ---
* S1 PMOS vdd-ctop (on during series phase)
XS1 ctop g_s1 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=150 nf=15
* S2 NMOS cbot-vout (series phase return switch)
XS2 vout g_s2 cbot vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=400 nf=20
* S3 NMOS ctop-vout (dump switch)
XS3 vout g_s34 ctop vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=400 nf=20
* S4 NMOS cbot-vss (dump phase ground switch)
XS4 cbot g_s34 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=60 nf=6

* --- flying capacitor ctop-cbot: 50 units ~= 1.00 nF ---

taskTitle: Design a two-phase switched-capacitor 2:1 step-down converter
circuit:
* =====================================================================
* Two-phase switched-capacitor 2:1 step-down converter (SKY130)
*
* Topology: series-parallel 2:1 with flying capacitor CF (nodes x1/x2)
* and output capacitor CO (vout/vss).
*   Phase 1 (clk high): S1 (vdd->x1, PMOS) and S2 (x2->vout, NMOS)
*       charge CF in series with the output node.
*   Phase 2 (clk low) : S3 (x1->vout) and S4 (x2->vss, NMOS) connect
*       CF in parallel with the output node.
*
* S2/S3 pass a mid-rail signal (~vdd/2) with their gates driven only to
* vdd, so they use low-Vt NMOS (standard-Vt NMOS with the vss body at
* this drive level nearly cuts off at the ss/-40 corner).  S1 (PMOS,
* source at vdd) and S4 (NMOS, source at vss) get full gate drive.
*
* Phase generation: NOR-latch non-overlap generator.  The latch feedback
* is tapped from the final power-gate driver outputs, so the
* break-before-make ordering follows the drivers over process corners.
* All logic is static CMOS: no steady-state current from vdd.
* =====================================================================

* ---------- helper cells ----------

* CMOS inverter, minimum size (clock pin, power-gate feedback taps)
.subckt inv1 in out vdd vss
XN out in vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1 nf=1
XP out in vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2.2 nf=1
.ends inv1

* CMOS inverter, medium (clock fanout, feedback delay elements)
.subckt inv2 in out vdd vss
XN out in vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=3 nf=1
XP out in vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=6.6 nf=1
.ends inv2

* CMOS inverter, first buffer stage of each power-gate chain
.subckt inv3 in out vdd vss
XN out in vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=8 nf=2
XP out in vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=18 nf=4
.ends inv3

* Final driver for S2 gate (g1, ~0.6 pF of LVT gate)
.subckt drvp1 in out vdd vss
XN out in vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=20 nf=4
XP out in vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=44 nf=8
.ends drvp1

* Final driver for S1 gate (gb1, ~0.4 pF of PMOS gate)
.subckt drvs1 in out vdd vss
XN out in vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=20 nf=4
XP out in vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=44 nf=8
.ends drvs1

* Final driver for S3/S4 gates (g2, ~0.75 pF of gate)
.subckt drvp2 in out vdd vss
XN out in vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=28 nf=6
XP out in vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=62 nf=13
.ends drvp2

* 2-input NOR gate (series PMOS pull-up, parallel NMOS pull-down)
.subckt nor2 a b out vdd vss
XPA mid a vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=10 nf=1
XPB out b mid vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=10 nf=1
XNA out a vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=6 nf=1
XNB out b vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=6 nf=1
.ends nor2

* ---------- converter ----------

.subckt sc_2to1_converter vss vdd clk vout

* --- flying capacitor CF ~= 500 pF (x1 top plate, x2 bottom plate)
XCF1 x1 x2 sky130_fd_pr__cap_mim_m3_1 w=500 l=250 mult=1
XCF2 x1 x2 sky130_fd_pr__cap_mim_m3_1 w=500 l=250 mult=1

* --- output capacitor CO ~= 405 pF
XCO1 vout vss sky130_fd_pr__cap_mim_m3_1 w=450 l=225 mult=1
XCO2 vout vss sky130_fd_pr__cap_mim_m3_1 w=450 l=225 mult=1

* --- power switches
* S1: vdd -> x1 (PMOS, on when gate is low, phase 1)
XS1 x1 gb1 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=240 nf=48
* S2: x2 -> vout (NMOS LVT, source rides near vdd/2, on phase 1)
XS2 x2 g1 vout vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=345 nf=69
* S3: x1 -> vout (NMOS LVT, source rides near vdd/2, on phase 2)
XS3 x1 g2 vout vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=345 nf=69
* S4: x2 -> vss (NMOS, full gate drive, on phase 2)
XS4 x2 g2 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=140 nf=28

* --- clock conditioning: ckm = clk (2 inverters), nckb = /clk (3 inverters)
XIA clk ckb vdd vss inv1
XIB ckb ckm vdd vss inv2
XIC ckm nckb vdd vss inv2

* --- non-overlap generator: p1/p2 are the phase commands.
* Each command is held low until the opposite phase's power gates have
* actually switched off (feedback tapped from the gates themselves).
XN1 nckb nfb2 p1 vdd vss nor2
XN2 ckm nfb1 p2 vdd vss nor2

* --- phase-1 drivers: g1 drives the S2 gate, gb1 drives the S1 gate.
* The S1 chain branches from d1 so both chains start together.
XD1A p1 d1 vdd vss inv3
XD1B d1 g1 vdd vss drvp1
XD1C d1 e1 vdd vss inv3
XD1D e1 gb1 vdd vss drvs1

* --- phase-2 driver: g2 drives the S3 and S4 gates
XD2A p2 d2 vdd vss inv3
XD2B d2 g2 vdd vss drvp2

* --- non-overlap feedback.
* nfb1 (holds p2 low) follows gb1: it only falls once S1 (the last
* phase-1 switch to release) is off.  Three inversions => active high
* during phase 1.  nfb2 (holds p1 low) follows g2 = S3/S4 gates.
XF1A gb1 f1a vdd vss inv1
XF1B f1a f1b vdd vss inv1
XF1C f1b nfb1 vdd vss inv2
XF2A g2 f2a vdd vss inv1
XF2B f2a nfb2 vdd vss inv2

.ends sc_2to1_converter

taskTitle: Design a two-phase switched-capacitor 2:1 step-down converter
circuit:
* Two-phase switched-capacitor 2:1 step-down converter (SKY130 devices).
*
* Series-parallel divider power stage:
*   phase 1 (p1 active): vdd -S1-> na -Cf-> nb -S3-> vout   (Cf charges, vout is fed)
*   phase 2 (p2 active): vout -S2-> na -Cf-> nb -S4-> vss   (Cf dumps into vout)
*   dead time separates the phases so no series switch pair conducts together.
*
* Steady state: vout = vdd/2 - iout*Req, with Req ~ 1/(4*Cf*fsw) plus switch resistance.

* ---------------------------------------------------------------- helpers --

* Static CMOS logic inverters, minimum size (used for the clock receiver,
* the non-overlap delay chains and the first driver stage).
.subckt sc_inv_a a z vss vdd
XMN z a vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.42 nf=1
XMP z a vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.84 nf=1
.ends sc_inv_a

* Intermediate driver stage.
.subckt sc_inv_b a z vss vdd
XMN z a vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2.5 nf=2
XMP z a vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=5 nf=2
.ends sc_inv_b

* Final driver stage for a single power-switch gate.
.subckt sc_inv_c a z vss vdd
XMN z a vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=15 nf=2
XMP z a vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=30 nf=2
.ends sc_inv_c

* Final driver stage for two power-switch gates.
.subckt sc_inv_d a z vss vdd
XMN z a vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=20 nf=2
XMP z a vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=40 nf=2
.ends sc_inv_d

* Two-input NAND, minimum size.
.subckt sc_nand_a a b z vss vdd
XMNA z a nint vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.42 nf=1
XMNB nint b vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.42 nf=1
XMPA z a vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.84 nf=1
XMPB z b vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.84 nf=1
.ends sc_nand_a

* MIM capacitor bank, binary weighted, one 100x100um unit (~20pF nominal).
.subckt sc_cap1 a b
XC a b sky130_fd_pr__cap_mim_m3_1 w=100 l=100 mult=1
.ends sc_cap1
.subckt sc_cap2 a b
XU1 a b sc_cap1
XU2 a b sc_cap1
.ends sc_cap2
.subckt sc_cap4 a b
XU1 a b sc_cap2
XU2 a b sc_cap2
.ends sc_cap4
.subckt sc_cap8 a b
XU1 a b sc_cap4
XU2 a b sc_cap4
.ends sc_cap8
.subckt sc_cap16 a b
XU1 a b sc_cap8
XU2 a b sc_cap8
.ends sc_cap16
.subckt sc_cap32 a b
XU1 a b sc_cap16
XU2 a b sc_cap16
.ends sc_cap32

* ------------------------------------------------------------ converter ----

.subckt sc_2to1_converter vss vdd clk vout

* ---- clock receiver: minimum size to keep the clock-source load tiny -----
Xick clk nclk vss vdd sc_inv_a

* ---- non-overlap phase generator ----------------------------------------
* p1n low -> phase 1 : p1n = NAND(clk, p2d)
* p2n low -> phase 2 : p2n = NAND(nclk, p1d)
* The feedback is delayed, so the turn-off edge of each phase is fast and the
* turn-on edge waits for the other phase to release.
Xg1 clk p2d p1n vss vdd sc_nand_a
Xg2 nclk p1d p2n vss vdd sc_nand_a
Xd1 p1n p1a vss vdd sc_inv_a
Xd2 p1a p1b vss vdd sc_inv_a
Xd3 p1b p1c vss vdd sc_inv_a
Xd4 p1c p1d vss vdd sc_inv_a
Xd5 p2n p2a vss vdd sc_inv_a
Xd6 p2a p2b vss vdd sc_inv_a
Xd7 p2b p2c vss vdd sc_inv_a
Xd8 p2c p2d vss vdd sc_inv_a

* ---- gate drivers -------------------------------------------------------
* phase 1: g1p (active low) drives the S1 PMOS gate, g1n (active high) drives S3.
Xb1 p1n q1 vss vdd sc_inv_a
Xb2 q1 g1p vss vdd sc_inv_b
Xb3 g1p g1n vss vdd sc_inv_c
* phase 2: g2p (active low) drives the S2 PMOS gate, g2n (active high) drives S2/S4.
Xc1 p2n q2 vss vdd sc_inv_a
Xc2 q2 g2p vss vdd sc_inv_b
Xc3 g2p g2n vss vdd sc_inv_d

* ---- power stage --------------------------------------------------------
* S1: vdd -> na   (PMOS, phase 1)
XS1 na g1p vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=150 nf=10
* S2/S3: the switches that carry current into vout see only vgs ~ vdd-vout
* with the full body bias of the shared substrate, so their on-resistance
* dominates the converter's output resistance.  The low-Vt flavour buys a
* ~3x lower ron at identical gate capacitance, which keeps the driver power
* (and therefore the light-load budget) unchanged.
XS2 na g2n vout vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=150 nf=10
* S3: nb -> vout  (NMOS, phase 1)
XS3 nb g1n vout vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=150 nf=10
* S4: nb -> vss   (NMOS, phase 2)
XS4 nb g2n vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=150 nf=10

* flying capacitor: 22 x 20pF units ~ 441pF nominal
XCf1 na nb sc_cap16
XCf2 na nb sc_cap4
XCf3 na nb sc_cap2

* output capacitor: 56 x 20pF units ~ 1.12nF nominal
XCo1 vout vss sc_cap32
XCo2 vout vss sc_cap16
XCo3 vout vss sc_cap8

.ends sc_2to1_converter

taskTitle: Design a two-phase switched-capacitor 2:1 step-down converter
circuit:
* ===========================================================================
*  sc_2to1_converter : transistor-level 2:1 switched-capacitor step-down
*
*  Topology (series-parallel divider, one flying capacitor):
*     phase 1 (clk high) : S1 vdd->n1, S2 n2->vout   Cf charges to Vdd-Vout,
*                          charge is delivered into vout
*     phase 2 (clk low)  : S3 n1->vout, S4 n2->vss   Cf is paralleled with
*                          Cout and discharges into vout
*
*  Both phases deliver charge to the output, so the current into vout is
*  continuous.  Break-before-make non-overlap is generated locally from clk.
* ===========================================================================

* ------------------------------- logic cells ------------------------------

* Small inverter used right at the clk input (keeps the 50 ohm source load low)
.subckt invi a y vss vdd
Xmp y a vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.68 nf=1 m=1
Xmn y a vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.84 nf=1 m=1
.ends invi

* Scalable inverter, unit width 6u PMOS / 3u NMOS, scale with m=
.subckt inv a y vss vdd
Xmp y a vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=6 nf=1 m=1
Xmn y a vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=3 nf=1 m=1
.ends inv

* Moderately long-channel inverter used as a delay element.  Stage delay is
* R*C with R ~ L/W and C ~ W*L, so it scales as L^2 and is set by L alone.
.subckt dinv a y vss vdd
Xmp y a vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1.5 w=0.84 nf=1 m=1
Xmn y a vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1.5 w=0.42 nf=1 m=1
.ends dinv

* Inverting delay line: five delay stages
.subckt dly a y vss vdd
Xd1 q1 a  vss vdd dinv
Xd2 q2 q1 vss vdd dinv
Xd3 q3 q2 vss vdd dinv
Xd4 q4 q3 vss vdd dinv
Xd5 y  q4 vss vdd dinv
.ends dly

* Two-input NAND
.subckt nand2 a b y vss vdd
Xmp1 y a vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.68 nf=1 m=1
Xmp2 y b vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.68 nf=1 m=1
Xmn1 y b iq vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.84 nf=1 m=1
Xmn2 iq a vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.84 nf=1 m=1
.ends nand2

* --------------------------- converter core -------------------------------

.subckt sc_2to1_converter vss vdd clk vout

* ---- clock input buffer: cb = /clk, c = clk ----
Xib1 clk cb vss vdd invi
Xib2 cb  c  vss vdd invi

* ---- break-before-make phase generation ----
*   phi1 = /(c  AND fb2),  fb2 = /delay(phi2)   -> phi1 rises late
*   phi2 = /(cb AND fb1),  fb1 = /delay(phi1)   -> phi2 rises late
Xnd1 c  fb2 d1 vss vdd nand2
Xgp1 d1 phi1 vss vdd inv m=2
Xnd2 cb fb1 d2 vss vdd nand2
Xgp2 d2 phi2 vss vdd inv m=3
Xdl1 phi1 fb1 vss vdd dly
Xdl2 phi2 fb2 vss vdd dly

* ---- gate driver for the PMOS high-side switch ----
Xgp3 phi1 phi1n vss vdd inv m=2

* ---- power switches ----
* S1  vdd  -> n1   (PMOS, on during phase 1)
Xs1 n1 phi1n vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=10 nf=1 m=26
* S2  n2   -> vout (low-Vt NMOS pass device, on during phase 1)
Xs2 n2 phi1 vout vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=10 nf=1 m=24
* S3  n1   -> vout (low-Vt NMOS pass device, on during phase 2)
Xs3 n1 phi2 vout vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=10 nf=1 m=24
* S4  n2   -> vss  (NMOS, on during phase 2)
Xs4 n2 phi2 vss  vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=10 nf=1 m=13

* ---- flying capacitor, 2.0 nF ----
Xcf1 n1 n2 sky130_fd_pr__cap_mim_m3_1 w=707 l=707 mult=1
Xcf2 n1 n2 sky130_fd_pr__cap_mim_m3_1 w=707 l=707 mult=1

* ---- output capacitor, 2.0 nF ----
Xco1 vout vss sky130_fd_pr__cap_mim_m3_1 w=707 l=707 mult=1
Xco2 vout vss sky130_fd_pr__cap_mim_m3_1 w=707 l=707 mult=1

.ends sc_2to1_converter

circuit:

* non-overlapping clock generation.
* Pin order: vss vdd clk vout

* Minimum-size inverter
.subckt INV_A a y vdd vss
XMN y a vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1 nf=1
XMP y a vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
.ends INV_A

* Medium driver inverter
.subckt INV_C a y vdd vss
XMN y a vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4 nf=1
XMP y a vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=8 nf=2
.ends INV_C

* Large driver inverter
.subckt INV_D a y vdd vss
XMN y a vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=3 nf=1
XMP y a vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=6 nf=1
.ends INV_D

* Two-input NOR
.subckt NOR2_A a b y vdd vss
XMN1 y a vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1 nf=1
XMN2 y b vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1 nf=1
XMP1 y a n1 vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4 nf=1
XMP2 n1 b vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4 nf=1
.ends NOR2_A

.subckt sc_2to1_converter vss vdd clk vout
* Input clock buffer
XI0 clk ckb vdd vss INV_A
XI1 ckb ck vdd vss INV_A
* Non-overlapping phase generation (cross-coupled NOR + delay chains)
XNR1 ckb ph2 n1 vdd vss NOR2_A
XI2 n1 d1 vdd vss INV_A
XI3 d1 d2 vdd vss INV_A
XI4 d2 d3 vdd vss INV_A
XI5 d3 ph1 vdd vss INV_A
XNR2 ck ph1 n2 vdd vss NOR2_A
XI6 n2 e1 vdd vss INV_A
XI7 e1 e2 vdd vss INV_A
XI8 e2 e3 vdd vss INV_A
XI9 e3 ph2 vdd vss INV_A
* Gate drivers
XI10 ph1 g1 vdd vss INV_C
XI11 ph1 n4 vdd vss INV_A
XI12 n4 g4 vdd vss INV_C
XI13 ph2 n23 vdd vss INV_A
XI14 n23 g23 vdd vss INV_D
* Power switches
*  M1: vdd -> fly_hi (phase 1, PMOS)
XM1 fh g1 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=160 nf=32
*  M2: fly_hi -> vout (phase 2, NMOS)
XM2 fh g23 vout vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=140 nf=28

XM3 fl g23 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=100 nf=20

XM4 vout g4 fl vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=140 nf=28
* Flying capacitor (~300 pF)
XCF fh fl sky130_fd_pr__cap_mim_m3_1 w=390 l=390 mult=1

taskTitle: Design a two-phase switched-capacitor 2:1 step-down converter
circuit:
* Two-phase switched-capacitor 2:1 step-down converter (sky130).
* Phases are derived from clk by a cross-coupled-NOR non-overlap generator.
* Gate drivers use fast-off/slower-on skewed final stages; the S1 driver is
* reduced-swing (vout..vdd) since S1's source sits at vdd, cutting its gate
* charge loss and returning the discharge charge to the output.
* Flying and output capacitors are on-chip MIM devices inside the DUT.

* --- unit inverter ---
.subckt inv_u a y vdd vss
XMN y a vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.5 nf=1
XMP y a vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.0 nf=2
.ends inv_u

* --- medium inverter ---
.subckt inv_m a y vdd vss
XMN y a vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2.0 nf=2
XMP y a vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4.0 nf=2
.ends inv_m

* --- final stage for PMOS power gate S2: P faster (fast off), N slower ---
.subckt inv_fp a y vdd vss
XMN y a vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=8.0 nf=4
XMP y a vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=16.0 nf=8
.ends inv_fp

* --- final stage for NMOS power gates: N faster (fast off), P slower ---
.subckt inv_fn a y vdd vss
XMN y a vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=16.0 nf=8
XMP y a vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=16.0 nf=8
.ends inv_fn

* --- reduced-swing final stage for S1: output swings vdd (off) .. vlo (on) ---
.subckt inv_rs a y vdd vlo vss
XMP y a vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=16.0 nf=8
XMN y a vlo vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=16.0 nf=8
.ends inv_rs

* --- unit 2-input NOR ---
.subckt nor2_u a b y vdd vss
XMP1 np a vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2.0 nf=2
XMP2 y b np vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2.0 nf=2
XMN1 y a vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.5 nf=1
XMN2 y b vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.5 nf=1
.ends nor2_u

.subckt sc_2to1_converter vss vdd clk vout
* ---- non-overlapping phase generation ----
XIC  clk  nclk vdd vss inv_u
* p1 high when clk high (after dead time); p2 high when clk low
XP1  nclk p2d  p1 vdd vss nor2_u
XP2  clk  p1d  p2 vdd vss nor2_u
* delay cells in the cross-coupling set the dead time
XD1a p1 p1d1 vdd vss inv_u
XD1b p1d1 p1d2 vdd vss inv_u
XD1c p1d2 p1d3 vdd vss inv_u
XD1d p1d3 p1d4 vdd vss inv_u
XD1e p1d4 p1d5 vdd vss inv_u
XD1f p1d5 p1d6 vdd vss inv_u
XD1g p1d6 p1d7 vdd vss inv_u
XD1h p1d7 p1d vdd vss inv_u
XD2a p2 p2d1 vdd vss inv_u
XD2b p2d1 p2d2 vdd vss inv_u
XD2c p2d2 p2d3 vdd vss inv_u
XD2d p2d3 p2d4 vdd vss inv_u
XD2e p2d4 p2d5 vdd vss inv_u
XD2f p2d5 p2d6 vdd vss inv_u
XD2g p2d6 p2d7 vdd vss inv_u
XD2h p2d7 p2d vdd vss inv_u

* ---- gate drivers ----
* S1 PMOS gate: pulled to vout during p1 (reduced swing, source is at vdd)
XG1a p1  n1a vdd vss inv_m
XG1b n1a n1b vdd vss inv_m
XG1c n1b p1g vdd vout vss inv_rs
* S2 PMOS gate: low during p2, full swing (its source drops toward vout)
XG2a p2  n2a vdd vss inv_m
XG2b n2a n2b vdd vss inv_m
XG2c n2b p2g vdd vss inv_fp
* S3 NMOS gate: high during p1, full swing (cbot falls to vss in p2)
XG3a p1  n3a vdd vss inv_m
XG3b n3a s3g vdd vss inv_fn
* S4 NMOS gate: high during p2, full swing
XG4a p2  n4a vdd vss inv_m
XG4b n4a s4g vdd vss inv_fn

* ---- power switches ----
XS1 ctop p1g vdd  vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=600 nf=120
XS2 vout p2g ctop vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=400 nf=80
XS3 cbot s3g vout vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=600 nf=120
XS4 cbot s4g vss  vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=300 nf=60

* ---- flying and output capacitors (MIM) ----
XCFLY ctop cbot sky130_fd_pr__cap_mim_m3_1 w=700 l=700 mult=1
XCOUT vout vss  sky130_fd_pr__cap_mim_m3_1 w=1000 l=1000 mult=1
.ends sc_2to1_converter
