taskTitle: Design a two-phase switched-capacitor 2:1 step-down converter
circuit:
* Two-phase switched-capacitor 2:1 step-down converter.
* clk is a 20 MHz rail-to-rail input. Two non-overlapping phases are derived
* on-chip with a cross-coupled NOR generator plus RC-delayed feedback.
* Phase 1 (clk high): S1/S2 connect the flying capacitor between vdd and vout.
* Phase 2 (clk low):  S3/S4 connect the flying capacitor across vout.

* --- Helper gates ---------------------------------------------------------
.subckt inv_s vss vdd a y
XN y a vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.42 nf=1
XP y a vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.84 nf=1
.ends inv_s

.subckt inv_m vss vdd a y
XN y a vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.5 nf=1
XP y a vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=3 nf=1
.ends inv_m

.subckt inv_b vss vdd a y
XN y a vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=6 nf=1
XP y a vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=12 nf=2
.ends inv_b

.subckt nor2_s vss vdd a b y
XN1 y a vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.42 nf=1
XN2 y b vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.42 nf=1
XP1 m b vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.84 nf=1
XP2 y a m vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.84 nf=1
.ends nor2_s

* RC delay cell: ~95 kOhm into ~20 fF, then two restoring inverters.
.subckt dly_s vss vdd a y
XR a m vss sky130_fd_pr__res_xhigh_po w=1 l=50 mult=1
XC m vss sky130_fd_pr__cap_mim_m3_1 w=3 l=3 mult=1
XI1 vss vdd m n inv_s
XI2 vss vdd n y inv_s
.ends dly_s

* --- Converter -------------------------------------------------------------
.subckt sc_2to1_converter vss vdd clk vout
* Clock buffer.
XI0 vss vdd clk clkb inv_s
XI1 vss vdd clkb ck inv_s

* Non-overlapping phase generation.
* p1 = ck  AND ~p2d,  p2 = ~ck AND ~p1d   (d = RC-delayed copy)
XG1 vss vdd clkb p2d p1 nor2_s
XG2 vss vdd ck   p1d p2 nor2_s
XD1 vss vdd p1 p1d dly_s
XD2 vss vdd p2 p2d dly_s

* Phase-1 gate drives: ph1 (NMOS switch S2) and ph1b (PMOS switch S1).
XB1 vss vdd p1  n1   inv_s
XB2 vss vdd n1  ph1  inv_m
XB3 vss vdd n1  n2   inv_m
XB4 vss vdd n2  ph1b inv_b

* Phase-2 gate drive: ph2 (NMOS switches S3 and S4).
XB5 vss vdd p2  n3  inv_s
XB6 vss vdd n3  ph2 inv_b

* Power stage. cf_top/cf_bot are the flying-capacitor nodes.
* S1: vdd -> cf_top, PMOS, on during phase 1 (gate ph1b active low).
XS1 vdd ph1b cf_top vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=500 nf=100
* S2: cf_bot -> vout, LVT NMOS, on during phase 1 (gate ph1).
XS2 cf_bot ph1 vout vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=350 nf=70
* S3: cf_top -> vout, LVT NMOS, on during phase 2 (gate ph2).
XS3 vout ph2 cf_top vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=350 nf=70
* S4: cf_bot -> vss, NMOS, on during phase 2 (gate ph2).
XS4 cf_bot ph2 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=200 nf=40

* Flying capacitor, ~600 pF MIM (2 fF/um^2).
XCF cf_top cf_bot sky130_fd_pr__cap_mim_m3_1 w=550 l=550 mult=1
* Output capacitor, ~500 pF MIM.
XCO vout vss sky130_fd_pr__cap_mim_m3_1 w=500 l=500 mult=1
.ends sc_2to1_converter

taskTitle: Design a two-phase switched-capacitor 2:1 step-down converter
circuit:
* =========================================================================
* sc_2to1_converter : two-phase switched-capacitor 2:1 step-down converter
* SKY130 PDK, transistor level.
*
* Power stage (series-parallel, soft-charged divider).  The flying cap Cf
* sits between the internal nodes nA/nB so that the output is supplied
* during BOTH phases and no charge-sharing spike ever reaches vout:
*
*   phase A (phi1) :  vdd --S1--> nA ==Cf== nB --S2--> vout
*   phase B (phi2) :  nA --S3--> vout      nB --S4--> vss
*
* phi1 / phi2 are derived on chip from clk by cross-coupled NORs.  Each
* NOR output is fed back into the opposite NOR through a non-inverting RC
* delay, which guarantees a dead time in both switching directions (one
* input of every NOR is always forced by clk, so the generator can neither
* latch up nor oscillate).
* =========================================================================

* ------------------------------------------------ 100 pF MIM capacitor
.subckt sc_cap100p a b
XC a b sky130_fd_pr__cap_mim_m3_1 w=224 l=224 mult=1
.ends sc_cap100p

* ------------------------------------------------ unit logic inverter
.subckt sc_inv a y vvss vvdd
XMN y a vvss vvss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.42 nf=1
XMP y a vvdd vvdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.74 nf=1
.ends sc_inv

* ------------------------------------------------ 2-input NOR
* parallel nmos pull-down, series pmos pull-up
.subckt sc_nor a b y vvss vvdd
XMN1 y a vvss vvss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.42 nf=1
XMN2 y b vvss vvss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.42 nf=1
XMP1 n1 a vvdd vvdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.74 nf=1
XMP2 y  b n1 vvdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.74 nf=1
.ends sc_nor

* ------------------------------------------------ weak long-channel inverter
* Measured ~55k output resistance (both edges, at this sizing).  Together
* with the mim cap in sc_dly it sets the cross-feedback delay and so the
* non-overlap interval, at almost no switching power.
.subckt sc_inv_slow a y vvss vvdd
XMN y a vvss vvss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=2.0 w=0.42 nf=1
XMP y a vvdd vvdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=2.0 w=3.4 nf=1
.ends sc_inv_slow

* ------------------------------------------------ gate driver inverter
.subckt sc_drv a y vvss vvdd
XMN y a vvss vvss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.84 nf=1
XMP y a vvdd vvdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=3.48 nf=1
.ends sc_drv

* ------------------------------------------------ non-inverting delay stage
.subckt sc_dly a y vvss vvdd
X1 a nd vvss vvdd sc_inv_slow
XD nd vvss sky130_fd_pr__cap_mim_m3_1 w=5.0 l=5.0 mult=1
X2 nd y vvss vvdd sc_inv
.ends sc_dly


* =========================================================================
.subckt sc_2to1_converter vss vdd clk vout

* clock input buffer: n2 = clk, n3 = /clk (equal stage count, matched skew)
XIB1 clk n1 vss vdd sc_inv
XIB2 n1  n2 vss vdd sc_inv
XIB3 n2  n3 vss vdd sc_inv

* non-overlap generator
XGA1 n3 pd2 phi1 vss vdd sc_nor
XGA2 n2 pd1 phi2 vss vdd sc_nor
XDL1 phi1 pd1 vss vdd sc_dly
XDL2 phi2 pd2 vss vdd sc_dly

* switch gate drivers
XDS1 phi1 g1 vss vdd sc_drv
XDS2 phi1 q2 vss vdd sc_drv
XDS2b q2  g2 vss vdd sc_drv
XDS3 phi2 q3 vss vdd sc_drv
XDS3b q3  g3 vss vdd sc_drv
XDS4 phi2 q4 vss vdd sc_drv
XDS4b q4  g4 vss vdd sc_drv

* power switches
*   S1  vdd -> nA    pmos, bulk = vdd
XS1 nA g1 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=210 nf=21
*   S2  nB  -> vout  nmos lvt, bulk = vss
XS2 nB g2 vout vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=185 nf=37
*   S3  nA  -> vout  nmos lvt, bulk = vss
XS3 nA g3 vout vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=135 nf=27
*   S4  nB  -> vss   nmos, bulk = vss
XS4 nB g4 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=74 nf=10

* flying capacitor, 1 nF total
XCF1 nA nB sc_cap100p
XCF2 nA nB sc_cap100p
XCF3 nA nB sc_cap100p
XCF4 nA nB sc_cap100p
XCF5 nA nB sc_cap100p
XCF6 nA nB sc_cap100p
XCF7 nA nB sc_cap100p
XCF8 nA nB sc_cap100p

* model, so caps are kept ripple/SSL limited for a fast startup.

XD13 d1b vdd vss d1c inv1
XD14 d1c vdd vss d1d inv1

XG12 g1a vdd vss g1 inv16

taskTitle: Design a two-phase switched-capacitor 2:1 step-down converter
circuit:
* 2:1 switched-capacitor step-down converter.
* External pins: vss vdd clk vout.
* Architecture:
*   phi1 (b high): S1 (PMOS vdd->cf_a) and S3 (NMOS cf_b->vout) on,
*                  flying cap charged from vdd while feeding vout.
*   phi2 (a high): S2 (NMOS cf_a->vout) and S4 (NMOS cf_b->vss) on,
*                  flying cap discharged into vout.
*   Cross-coupled NOR SR with delayed feedback derives non-overlap.
* MIM in this PDK build: area-only 2 fF/um^2, mult honored, mf ignored.

* ---- logic / buffer helpers ----
.subckt sc_inv1 vss vdd a y
XN y a vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.5 nf=1
XP y a vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=3 nf=1
.ends sc_inv1

.subckt sc_inv2 vss vdd a y
XN y a vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=8 nf=2
XP y a vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=16 nf=2
.ends sc_inv2

.subckt sc_bufa vss vdd a y
XN y a vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=20 nf=2
XP y a vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=40 nf=2
.ends sc_bufa

.subckt sc_bufb vss vdd a y
XN y a vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=30 nf=3
XP y a vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=60 nf=3
.ends sc_bufb

.subckt sc_bufc vss vdd a y
XN y a vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=40 nf=4
XP y a vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=80 nf=4
.ends sc_bufc

.subckt sc_nor2 vss vdd a b y
XN1 y a vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
XN2 y b vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
XP1 y a vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=5 nf=1
XP2 y b vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=5 nf=1
.ends sc_nor2

* ---- top level DUT ----
.subckt sc_2to1_converter vss vdd clk vout

* complementary clock
XCLKN vss vdd clk clkn sc_inv1

* cross-coupled NOR SR: a=phi2, b=phi1
XNA vss vdd clk bd a sc_nor2
XNB vss vdd clkn ad b sc_nor2

* delay feedback chains (4 inverters each -> non-overlap gap)
XAD1 vss vdd a ad1 sc_inv1
XAD2 vss vdd ad1 ad2 sc_inv1
XAD3 vss vdd ad2 ad3 sc_inv1
XAD4 vss vdd ad3 ad sc_inv1
XBD1 vss vdd b bd1 sc_inv1
XBD2 vss vdd bd1 bd2 sc_inv1
XBD3 vss vdd bd2 bd3 sc_inv1
XBD4 vss vdd bd3 bd sc_inv1

* shared prebuffers (inverting)
XPBA vss vdd a an sc_inv2
XPBB vss vdd b bn sc_inv2

* power switches
* S1 PMOS vdd->cf_a, on phi1 (gate low = ~b)
XS1 cf_a g1 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=120 nf=6
* S2 NMOS cf_a->vout, on phi2
XS2 cf_a g2 vout vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=120 nf=6
* S3 NMOS cf_b->vout, on phi1
XS3 cf_b g3 vout vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=160 nf=8
* S4 NMOS cf_b->vss, on phi2
XS4 cf_b g4 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=80 nf=4

* gate drives
* g1 = ~b : b -> inv1 -> inv2 -> bufb (3 stages, odd)
XG11 vss vdd b g11 sc_inv1
XG12 vss vdd g11 g12 sc_inv2
XG13 vss vdd g12 g1 sc_bufb
* g3 = b : b -> inv2 (shared bn) -> bufc
XG31 vss vdd bn g3 sc_bufc
* g2 = a : a -> inv2 (shared an) -> bufb
XG21 vss vdd an g2 sc_bufb
* g4 = a : a -> inv2 (shared an) -> bufa
XG41 vss vdd an g4 sc_bufa

* flying capacitor ~700 pF: (592.15)^2 um^2 * 2 fF/um^2 = 697 pF
XCFLY cf_a cf_b sky130_fd_pr__cap_mim_m3_1 w=592 l=592 mult=1
* output capacitor ~2.5 nF: (1118.15)^2 * 2 fF = 2.50 nF
XCOUT vout vss sky130_fd_pr__cap_mim_m3_1 w=1118 l=1118 mult=1

.ends sc_2to1_converter

taskTitle: Design a two-phase switched-capacitor 2:1 step-down converter
circuit:
* Two-phase switched-capacitor 2:1 step-down converter.
* Topology: 2:1 series-parallel (voltage halver).
*   Phase PHI1 (clk low):  S1 connects VDD->cf_t,  S2 connects cf_b->vout  (Cf in series Vdd->Vout)
*   Phase PHI2 (clk high): S3 connects cf_t->vout, S4 connects cf_b->vss   (Cf in parallel with CL)
* Non-overlap generator: PHI1 = NOR(clk, PHI2d), PHI2 = NOR(!clk, PHI1d),
*   PHI*d = PHI* delayed by an even inverter chain -> real dead time, no shoot-through.
* All energy for gate drive is drawn from VDD (logic/buffers) except the tiny
* first-stage input, which is the only load on the 50 ohm clock source.

* ---------- logic helpers (fixed geometry, all literals) ----------
.subckt inv in out vss vdd
XMN out in vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.5 nf=2
XMP out in vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=3 nf=2
.ends inv

.subckt invb in out vss vdd
XMN out in vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=8 nf=4
XMP out in vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=16 nf=4
.ends invb

.subckt invd in out vss vdd
XMN out in vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=40 nf=20
XMP out in vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=80 nf=20
.ends invd

.subckt nor2 a b out vss vdd
XMP1 nx a vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=3 nf=2
XMP2 out b nx vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=3 nf=2
XMN1 out a vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.5 nf=2
XMN2 out b vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.5 nf=2
.ends nor2

* ---------- DUT ----------
.subckt sc_2to1_converter vss vdd clk vout

* non-overlap phase generator
Xinv_d clk d vss vdd inv
Xnor1 clk phi2d phi1 vss vdd nor2
Xnor2 d phi1d phi2 vss vdd nor2
* even inverter delay chains (dead time)
Xda phi1 dd1a vss vdd inv
Xdb dd1a phi1d vss vdd inv
Xdc phi2 dd2a vss vdd inv
Xdd dd2a phi2d vss vdd inv

* phase-1 buffer: p1d = PHI1 (drives S2 gate); phi1n = !PHI1 (drives high-side PMOS)
Xb1a phi1 p1 vss vdd invb
Xb1b p1 p1d vss vdd invd
Xb1n p1d phi1n vss vdd invd
* phase-2 buffer: p2d = PHI2 (drives S3,S4 gates), even #inverters
Xb2a phi2 p2 vss vdd invb
Xb2b p2 p2d vss vdd invd

* flying and output capacitors (MIM)
XCF cf_t cf_b sky130_fd_pr__cap_mim_m3_1 w=1100 l=1100 mult=1
XCL vout vss sky130_fd_pr__cap_mim_m3_1 w=900 l=900 mult=1

* S1: VDD <-> cf_t  (PMOS, on during PHI1; gate phi1n = !PHI1)
XS1 cf_t phi1n vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=120 nf=40
* S2: cf_b <-> vout (LVT NMOS, on during PHI1; gate p1d = PHI1)
XS2 cf_b p1d vout vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=100 nf=40
* S3: cf_t <-> vout (LVT NMOS, on during PHI2; gate p2d = PHI2)
XS3 cf_t p2d vout vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=100 nf=40
* S4: cf_b <-> vss (NMOS, on during PHI2; gate p2d = PHI2)
XS4 cf_b p2d vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=100 nf=40

.ends sc_2to1_converter

taskTitle: Design a two-phase switched-capacitor 2:1 step-down converter
circuit:
* 2:1 switched-capacitor step-down converter (sky130)
* Top-level DUT: derives two non-overlapping phases from clk and drives
* a transistor-level 2:1 series-parallel switched-capacitor power stage.
* Flying capacitor and output capacitor are internal to the DUT.
*
* Phase 1 (phi1, clk high): vdd -> S1 -> ftop --Cf-- fbot -> S2 -> vout  (series charge)
* Phase 2 (phi2, clk low):  ftop -> S3 -> vout , fbot -> S4 -> vss       (parallel discharge)

* ---------- helper cells (fixed geometry, literal sizes) ----------
.subckt inv_s in out vdd vss
XN out in vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=2
XP out in vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4 nf=2
.ends inv_s
.subckt inv_m in out vdd vss
XN out in vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=8 nf=4
XP out in vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=16 nf=4
.ends inv_m
.subckt inv_l in out vdd vss
XN out in vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=30 nf=6
XP out in vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=60 nf=12
.ends inv_l

* 2-input NOR: out = NOR(a,b)
.subckt nor2 a b out vdd vss
XN1 out a nmid vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4 nf=2
XN2 nmid b vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4 nf=2
XP1 out a vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=8 nf=2
XP2 out b vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=8 nf=2
.ends nor2

* transmission-gate switch: passes a<->b; gn=NMOS gate (active hi), gp=PMOS gate (active lo)
.subckt tg a b gn gp vdd vss
XN a gn b vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=100 nf=20
XP a gp b vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=200 nf=40
.ends tg

* ---------- DUT ----------
.subckt sc_2to1_converter vss vdd clk vout
* Non-overlap phase generator (cross-coupled NOR).
* phi1 active when clk high (series/charge phase), phi2 active when clk low (parallel/discharge phase).
XIC clk clkb vdd vss inv_s
XN1 clkb phi2_lo phi1_lo vdd vss nor2
XN2 clk phi1_lo phi2_lo vdd vss nor2

* Phase-1 domain buffered complementary drives (phi1 active hi, phi1b active lo).
* phi1_lo -> inv_s -> inv_m -> inv_l : 4 inversions => phi1 (= phi1_lo, strong)
XB1 phi1_lo p1a vdd vss inv_s
XB2 p1a p1b vdd vss inv_m
XB3 p1b phi1b vdd vss inv_l
XB4 phi1b phi1 vdd vss inv_l
* Phase-2 domain buffered complementary drives (phi2 active hi, phi2b active lo).
XB5 phi2_lo p2a vdd vss inv_s
XB6 p2a p2b vdd vss inv_m
XB7 p2b phi2b vdd vss inv_l
XB8 phi2b phi2 vdd vss inv_l

* 2:1 series-parallel power stage.
XS1 vdd ftop phi1 phi1b vdd vss tg
XS2 fbot vout phi1 phi1b vdd vss tg
XS3 ftop vout phi2 phi2b vdd vss tg
XS4 fbot vss phi2 phi2b vdd vss tg

* Flying capacitor (MIM value scales with w*l area; mult only affects mismatch statistics)
XCF ftop fbot sky130_fd_pr__cap_mim_m3_1 w=1000 l=600 mult=1
* Output capacitor
XCOUT vout vss sky130_fd_pr__cap_mim_m3_1 w=1000 l=400 mult=1
.ends sc_2to1_converter

taskTitle: Design a two-phase switched-capacitor 2:1 step-down converter
circuit:
* Two-phase 2:1 switched-capacitor step-down converter.
* Pins: vss vdd clk vout. Switching phases and non-overlap are derived
* internally from clk; flying and output capacitors are on chip.
* All devices are SKY130 PDK subcircuits (no ideal elements).
*
* Power stage (2:1 ladder), internal nodes ctop/cbot:
*   phi1: S1 (vdd-ctop) and S3 (cbot-vout, transmission gate) on
*   phi2: S2 (ctop-vout) and S4 (cbot-vss) on
* Gate drives are full 0..vdd swings; S2/S3 see only ~vdd/2 gate drive
* in their on phase, so they are low-Vt devices.

* ---- small inverter (Wn=1, Wp=2) ----
.subckt sx_inv_s a y vss vdd
XN y a vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1 nf=1
XP y a vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
.ends sx_inv_s

* ---- small 2-input NAND (Wn=1 each, Wp=2 each) ----
.subckt sx_nand2_s a b y vss vdd
XN1 nint a vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1 nf=1
XN2 y b nint vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1 nf=1
XP1 y a vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
XP2 y b vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
.ends sx_nand2_s

* ---- 4-stage tapered buffer, sized for an nmos gate load (~300um eq) ----
.subckt sx_chain_n in out vss vdd
XI1 in n1 vss vdd sx_inv_s
XN2 n2 n1 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=7 nf=1
XP2 n2 n1 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=14 nf=1
XN3 n3 n2 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=40 nf=2
XP3 n3 n2 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=80 nf=4
XN4 out n3 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=230 nf=12
XP4 out n3 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=460 nf=24
.ends sx_chain_n

* ---- 4-stage (even inversion) tapered buffer for active-low pmos commands ----
.subckt sx_chain_p in out vss vdd
XI1 in p1 vss vdd sx_inv_s
XN2 p2 p1 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=8 nf=1
XP2 p2 p1 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=16 nf=1
XN3 p3 p2 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=55 nf=3
XP3 p3 p2 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=110 nf=6
XN4 out p3 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=375 nf=19
XP4 out p3 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=750 nf=38
.ends sx_chain_p

* ===================== DUT =====================
.subckt sc_2to1_converter vss vdd clk vout
* --- input buffering and self-timed non-overlap phase generator ---
XAB clk clkb vss vdd sx_inv_s

XX2 clkb gp1 x2 vss vdd sx_nand2_s

XY2 x2 y2 vss vdd sx_inv_s

XG2N y2 gn2 vss vdd sx_chain_n
XG2P x2 gp2 vss vdd sx_chain_p

* S3: cbot -> vout (phi1) transmission gate, ~vdd/2 drive: lvt devices

XS3P cbot gp1 vout vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=0.35 w=400 nf=20
* S4: cbot -> vss (phi2), full gate drive: regular nfet
XS4 cbot gn2 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=300 nf=15
* --- flying capacitor (~0.4 nF) and output capacitor (~1 nF) ---

.ends sc_2to1_converter

.subckt inv in out vss vdd

.ends inv

* Helper: large inverter for driving power switch gates
.subckt inv_lg in out vss vdd
XN out in vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4.2 nf=10
XP out in vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=8.4 nf=10
.ends inv_lg

* Helper: 2-input NOR
.subckt nor2 a b out vss vdd
XPA mid a vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.68 nf=2
XPB out b mid vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.68 nf=2
XNA out a vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.84 nf=2
XNB out b vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.84 nf=2
.ends nor2

* 2:1 switched-capacitor step-down converter
* Standard Dickson-like topology:
* Phase 1 (phi1): S1 ON (VDD->top_cfly), S2 ON (bot_cfly->VSS). Cfly charges to ~VDD.
* Phase 2 (phi2): S3 ON (top_cfly->VOUT), S4 ON (VDD->bot_cfly). Cfly delivers to VOUT.
.subckt sc_2to1_converter vss vdd clk vout

* Generate clock complement
XINV_CLK clk clk_bar vss vdd inv

* Cross-coupled NOR latch for non-overlapping clock phases
XNOR1 clk_bar phi2_int phi1_int vss vdd nor2
XNOR2 clk phi1_int phi2_int vss vdd nor2

* Buffer clock phases
XINV1 phi1_int phi1_n vss vdd inv
XINV2 phi1_n phi1 vss vdd inv_lg
XINV3 phi2_int phi2_n vss vdd inv
XINV4 phi2_n phi2 vss vdd inv_lg

* S1: LVT NMOS, VDD to top_cfly, gate=phi1 (source follower)
* top_cfly charges to VDD-Vth_lvt during phase 1
XS1 vdd phi1 top_cfly vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.35 w=20 nf=10

* S2: regular NMOS, bot_cfly to VSS, gate=phi1
* Discharges bot_cfly to 0V during phase 1
XS2 bot_cfly phi1 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=10 nf=10

* S3: regular NMOS, top_cfly to VOUT, gate=phi2
* Delivers charge from Cfly to VOUT during phase 2
XS3 top_cfly phi2 vout vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=30 nf=10

* S4: LVT NMOS, VDD to bot_cfly, gate=phi2 (source follower)
* Charges bot_cfly toward VDD-Vth_lvt during phase 2
XS4 vdd phi2 bot_cfly vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.35 w=20 nf=10

* Flying capacitor (~1nF)
XCF top_cfly bot_cfly sky130_fd_pr__cap_mim_m3_1 w=700 l=700 mult=1

* Output capacitor (~1nF)
XCOUT vout vss sky130_fd_pr__cap_mim_m3_1 w=700 l=700 mult=1

.ends sc_2to1_converter

taskTitle: Design a two-phase switched-capacitor 2:1 step-down converter
circuit:
* Two-phase switched-capacitor 2:1 step-down converter
* sc_2to1_converter vss vdd clk vout
*
* Phase A (clk=1/nclk=0): flying cap between VDD and VOUT
* Phase B (clk=0/nclk=1): flying cap between VOUT and VSS
* Non-overlapping phase drives to avoid Cfly shoot-through:
*   nclkf = fast ~clk (CMOS inverter)  -> XS1 off quickly at phase-B start
*   nclks = slow  ~clk (ratioed inv)   -> XS2 on late at phase-B start

* ---------- transmission gate helper ----------
.subckt tg a b ph phn vdd vss
XP a phn b vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=160 nf=4
XN a ph b vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=120 nf=2
.ends tg

.subckt sc_2to1_converter vss vdd clk vout

* ---------- fast nclk : ~clk (CMOS inverter, no DC path) ----------
XP nclkf clk vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=120 nf=2
XN nclkf clk vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=120 nf=2

* ---------- slow nclk : ~clk (ratioed inverter, slow rise for dead time) ----------
XP nclks vss vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=30 nf=2    ; weak pull-up
XN nclks clk vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=100 nf=4  ; pull-down

* ---------- flying and output capacitors ----------
CFLY flyp flyq 1n
COUT vout vss 10n

* ---------- power switches ----------
* Phase A: S1 flyp=vdd (PMOS gate=nclkf, on when nclkf=0), S4 flyq=vout (clk=1)
XS1 flyp nclkf vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=400 nf=4   ; PMOS vdd->flyp
XS4 flyq vout clk nclkf vdd vss tg                                   ; flyq->vout
* Phase B: S2 flyq=vss (NMOS gate=nclks, on late), S3 flyp=vout (nclkf=1)
XS2 flyq nclks vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=400 nf=4   ; NMOS flyq->vss
XS3 flyp vout nclkf clk vdd vss tg                                   ; flyp->vout

.ends sc_2to1_converter

taskTitle: Design a two-phase switched-capacitor 2:1 step-down converter
circuit:
* Two-phase switched-capacitor 2:1 step-down converter (topology A)
* Phase phi1: flying cap C1 between VDD and VOUT (c1t->VDD, c1b->VOUT).
* Phase phi2: C1 between VOUT and VSS (c1t->VOUT, c1b->VSS).
* Self-regulates at VDD/2; VDD tops up only the charge the load removes.
* Non-overlapping phases are derived internally from clk.

.subckt sc_2to1_converter vss vdd clk vout
* ---------- phase generator: non-overlapping ph1/ph2 from clk ----------
* xn = ~clk
XI0n xn clk vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1 nf=1
XI0p xn clk vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
* y = xn delayed by RC  (y = ~clk delayed by tau)
XRd xn y vss sky130_fd_pr__res_high_po w=1 l=77
XCd y vss sky130_fd_pr__cap_mim_m3_1 w=23 l=23 mult=1
* d = ~y = clk delayed by tau
XI1n d y vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1 nf=1
XI1p d y vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
* ph1 = clk & d   (on during clk high, turns on after tau, off at clk fall)
* n1 = ~(clk & d): series nfets (clk,d), parallel pfets (clk,d)
XN1a n1 d na vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
XN1b na clk vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
XP1a n1 clk vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4 nf=1
XP1b n1 d vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4 nf=1
XI3n ph1 n1 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4 nf=1
XI3p ph1 n1 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=8 nf=1
* ph2 = xn & y    (on during clk low, turns on after tau, off at clk rise)
* n2 = ~(xn & y): series nfets (xn,y), parallel pfets (xn,y)
XN2a n2 y nb vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
XN2b nb xn vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
XP2a n2 xn vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4 nf=1
XP2b n2 y vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4 nf=1
XI4n ph2 n2 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4 nf=1
XI4p ph2 n2 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=8 nf=1
* buffered complementary drives for the power TGs
XI5n ph1b ph1 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=40 nf=4
XI5p ph1b ph1 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=80 nf=4
XI6n ph2b ph2 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=40 nf=4
XI6p ph2b ph2 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=80 nf=4
* ---------- power stage ----------
* S1: VDD <-> c1t, closed on phi1 (TG)
XS1n c1t ph1 vdd vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=150 nf=2
XS1p c1t ph1b vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=300 nf=2
* S2: c1b <-> vout, closed on phi1 (TG)
XS2n c1b ph1 vout vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=150 nf=2
XS2p c1b ph1b vout vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=300 nf=2
* S3: c1t <-> vout, closed on phi2 (TG)
XS3n c1t ph2 vout vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=150 nf=2
XS3p c1t ph2b vout vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=300 nf=2
* S4: c1b <-> vss, closed on phi2 (nfet pulls c1b to VSS)
XS4 c1b ph2 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=150 nf=2
* ---------- capacitors (all inside the DUT) ----------
XC1 c1t c1b sky130_fd_pr__cap_mim_m3_1 w=1000 l=500 mult=1
XCOUT vout vss sky130_fd_pr__cap_mim_m3_1 w=1000 l=500 mult=1
.ends sc_2to1_converter

taskTitle: Design a two-phase switched-capacitor 2:1 step-down converter
circuit:
* 2:1 switched-capacitor step-down converter
* Derives two non-overlapping phases from clk and drives a series-parallel
* 2:1 SC power stage (flying cap Cf, output cap Co) using transmission-gate
* switches so each switch passes the full 0..VDD range with low resistance.
*
* Topology (per half period):
*   Phase 1 (phi1): flying cap in series VDD - Cf - Vout  (charge phase)
*     S1 ties Cf-top to VDD, S2 ties Cf-bot to Vout.
*   Phase 2 (phi2): flying cap in series Vout - Cf - VSS  (discharge phase)
*     S3 ties Cf-top to Vout, S4 ties Cf-bot to VSS.
*
* Helper: minimum inverter.
.subckt inv vss vdd a y
XMN y a vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1 nf=2
XMP y a vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=2
.ends inv

* Helper: medium inverter.
.subckt invm vss vdd a y
XMN y a vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=5 nf=3
XMP y a vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=10 nf=3
.ends invm

* Helper: strong inverter (final gate-drive stage).
.subckt invl vss vdd a y
XMN y a vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=12 nf=4
XMP y a vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=24 nf=4
.ends invl

* Helper: 2-input NOR.
.subckt nor2 vss vdd a b y
XMN1 y a vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1 nf=2
XMN2 y b vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1 nf=2
XMP1 y a n1 vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=2
XMP2 n1 b vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=2
.ends nor2

* Tapered phase driver: yn = a (NMOS gate), yp = ~yn (PMOS gate).
* Both outputs switch with matched, fast edges so the transmission gate turns
* on and off cleanly (no self cross-conduction).
.subckt drv vss vdd a yn yp
XM1 vss vdd a n1 invm
XM2 vss vdd n1 yn invl
XI  vss vdd yn yp invl
.ends drv

* Transmission gate: gn=NMOS gate, gp=PMOS gate, a-b terminals.
.subckt tg vss vdd gn gp a b
XMN a gn b vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=120 nf=24
XMP a gp b vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=240 nf=48
.ends tg

.subckt sc_2to1_converter vss vdd clk vout
* ---- Non-overlapping phase generator ----
* phi1 = NOR(clk, dphi2), phi2 = NOR(clkb, dphi1), even-delay feedback so each
* phase only rises after the other has fallen (guaranteed dead time).
Xiclk vss vdd clk clkb inv
Xd1a vss vdd phi1 p1a inv
Xd1b vss vdd p1a p1b inv
Xd1c vss vdd p1b p1c inv
Xd1d vss vdd p1c dphi1 inv
Xd2a vss vdd phi2 p2a inv
Xd2b vss vdd p2a p2b inv
Xd2c vss vdd p2b p2c inv
Xd2d vss vdd p2c dphi2 inv
Xn1 vss vdd clk dphi2 phi1 nor2
Xn2 vss vdd clkb dphi1 phi2 nor2
* Matched phase drivers.
Xd1 vss vdd phi1 phi1n phi1p drv
Xd2 vss vdd phi2 phi2n phi2p drv

* ---- 2:1 power stage ----
* Flying capacitor Cf (~1 nF).
XCF ca cb sky130_fd_pr__cap_mim_m3_1 w=700 l=700 mult=1
* Output capacitor Co (~1 nF).
XCO vout vss sky130_fd_pr__cap_mim_m3_1 w=700 l=700 mult=1
* Phase-1 switches.
XS1 vss vdd phi1n phi1p ca vdd tg
XS2 vss vdd phi1n phi1p cb vout tg
* Phase-2 switches.
XS3 vss vdd phi2n phi2p ca vout tg
XS4 vss vdd phi2n phi2p cb vss tg
.ends sc_2to1_converter
